x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

BankConnection.title: Bank Connection
BankConnection.description: A PSD2 AIS bank connection authorising access to one or more bank accounts via an openconnector aggregator source. Credentials live in openconnector; this record carries the consent reference only.

connectionNumber.description: Operator-readable reference for this bank connection.

aggregator.description: PSD2 AIS aggregator providing the connection. Credentials live in the corresponding openconnector Source record.

aggregatorSourceSlug.description: FK to the openconnector Source slug that holds the aggregator OAuth credentials. shillinq carries this reference only; credentials never land here.

bankBic.description: BIC/SWIFT code of the bank the connection covers.

bankCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the bank.

bankAccountIban.description: IBAN of the linked bank account.

consentReference.description: Aggregator-issued consent identifier returned from the SCA flow. Non-credential metadata — NOT an OAuth token or client secret.

consentGrantedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent was granted.

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent expires. PSD2 mandates SCA renewal every 90 days.

lastSyncAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful transaction pull.

lifecycleState.description: Current PSD2 consent lifecycle state.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this bank connection.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: SCA consent flow not yet completed; connection not usable.

active.label: Active
active.description: Consent granted and valid; transaction polling enabled.

expiring.label: Expiring
expiring.description: Consent expires within 14 days; operator must trigger renewal.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Consent has lapsed; transaction polling suspended until renewed.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.description: Operator or bank revoked consent; connection permanently disabled.

activate.label: Activate connection
activate.description: SCA consent flow completed successfully; activate the connection.

expire.label: Mark as expired
expire.description: Auto-transition fires when consentExpiresAt is reached.

renew.label: Renew consent
renew.description: Operator triggered SCA renewal via openconnector source reauthorise action; updates consentReference and consentExpiresAt on success.

onEnterExpiring.description: Notify configured recipient 14 days before consent expires.

consentRemainingDays.description: Number of days until the PSD2 consent expires. Negative when already expired.

shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.name: Bank transaction polling
shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.description: Pulls transactions from the PSD2 aggregator via the openconnector source slug, normalises the aggregator JSON to CAMT.053 XML, attaches the XML via docudesk, and creates a BankStatement record per active BankConnection. Runs 4× daily per REQ-BC-004. No BankPollingJob extends TimedJob.

BankStatement.title: Bank Statement
BankStatement.description: A CAMT.053 bank statement generated by the scheduled transaction polling workflow from aggregator data. The generated XML is attached via docudesk.

bankConnectionId.description: FK to the BankConnection that sourced this statement.

statementFormat.description: CAMT XML format version of the generated statement.

statementDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the statement generation run.

statementAttachmentUri.description: docudesk attachment URI referencing the generated CAMT.053 XML document.

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions included in this statement.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this statement.

onNewStatement.description: Notify the configured bank-connection operator when a new statement is available. Declarative fan-out per ADR-031; no BankNotificationService.

bankConnection.description: The PSD2 bank connection that generated this statement.

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: A double-entry general-ledger posting header. Owns the lifecycle and the balance invariant; child GLLine rows carry the debit/credit amounts per REQ-GL-001.

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction number unique per administration + fiscal year.

postingDate.description: Effective accounting date of the posting.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod record (T3 introduces the schema; T1 accepts any string). Auto-resolved on the post transition per REQ-GL-006.

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for this posting.

sourceReference.description: External document number (invoice no., bank statement ref, asset repair ID, etc.).

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: under construction; posted: immutable and in trial balance; reversed: superseded by a compensating transaction.

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry that materialised this posting, if any.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this posting.

reversesTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction that this transaction reverses. Required on the reversed transaction for the reversal guard.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines may be added, edited, or deleted.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. Header and lines are locked; appears in trial balance (T3).

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Superseded by a compensating transaction. Excluded from balance aggregations but remains queryable for audit.

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Transition draft posting to posted state. Enforces balance invariant and account-state guard. After balance check passes, evaluates active per-posting AllocationRule records per REQ-CC-004 + design D2.

actions.description: Evaluate all active AllocationRule records with cadence=per-posting whose sourceAccountPattern matches a line in this transaction. Emits additional balanced GLLine rows distributing source amounts per the rule targets per REQ-CC-004.

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Mark this transaction as reversed. A compensating GLTransaction referencing this one via reversesTransactionId must exist.

lines.description: All GLLine rows belonging to this transaction.

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: A debit-or-credit line within a GLTransaction, encoding the polarity in the side enum per REQ-GL-003. Extended with eliminationFlag to support GR consolidation per REQ-GRC-003.

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.

amount.description: Non-negative posting amount in the transaction's currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the parent GLTransaction.currency (T1 single-currency invariant).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod. Auto-resolved by the lifecycle engine on the GLTransaction.post transition.

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator; T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers.

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType is not none.

costCenter.description: Cost-center or department code for allocation reporting.

eliminationFlag.description: When true, excludes this line from the consolidated trial-balance and financial-statement aggregations. Used to eliminate inter-GR transactions from consolidated views per REQ-GRC-003.

costCenterCode.description: FK to CostCenter.code for analytical cost-center reporting. Backwards-compatible with the existing costCenter field per REQ-CC-003.

kostenDragerCode.description: FK to KostenDrager.code for cost-unit analytical reporting per REQ-CC-003.

projectCode.description: FK to Project.code for project accounting and WBSO time-per-project pre-positioning per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-CC-007.

dimensions.description: Free-form key-to-value map for custom analytical dimensions. Each key MUST match a registered custom dimension register declared with x-openregister-purpose: dimension; each value MUST resolve to an existing record code in that register. Validation is declared via OR relations engine per REQ-CC-003.

parentTransaction.description: The parent GLTransaction that owns this line.

account.description: FK to Account.accountNumber (bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts). Requires Account.lifecycleState = active on the post transition.

costCenterRelation.description: FK to CostCenter.code for dimension-tagged analytical reporting per REQ-CC-003.

kostenDragerRelation.description: FK to KostenDrager.code for cost-unit analytical reporting per REQ-CC-003.

projectRelation.description: FK to Project.code for project accounting and WBSO time-per-project per REQ-CC-003 + REQ-CC-007.

consolidatedTrialBalance.description: Trial-balance rollup that excludes inter-GR lines flagged for elimination. Produces debit and credit totals per accountNumber for the GR own jaarrekening per REQ-GRC-003.

segmentPnlByCostCenter.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by costCenterCode and fiscalYearId. Aggregates debit and credit amounts per cost center, rolling child cost centers up to their parent via the CostCenter self-relation per REQ-CC-005. Consumed by launchpad widgets via runtime GraphQL and by CostCenter detail pages.

segmentPnlByKostenDrager.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by kostenDragerCode and fiscalYearId. Mirrors the cost-center aggregation for the kostendrager dimension per REQ-CC-005.

segmentPnlByProject.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by projectCode and fiscalYearId. Used for project accounting and as the time-per-project projection target for WBSO pre-positioning per REQ-CC-005 + REQ-CC-007.

GRDeelnemer.title: GR Deelnemer
GRDeelnemer.description: A deelnemer (participating municipality, province, or waterboard) of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (GR). Holds the quotum-aandeel and an optional cross-administration FK for doorbelasting materialisation per REQ-GRC-001.

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the deelnemer's own shillinq administration. When set, a balanced GLTransaction is materialised in that administration on GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.

aandeel.description: Quotum-aandeel (participation share) of this deelnemer in the GR. Must be 0 ≤ x ≤ 1. The sum across all actief deelnemers SHOULD equal 1.0.

actief.description: Whether this deelnemer currently participates in the GR. Inactive deelnemers are excluded from the aandeel-sum invariant check.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the deelnemer record.

active.label: Active
active.description: Deelnemer participates in the GR and is included in aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Deelnemer no longer participates. Historical records remain queryable; excluded from aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archive.label: Archive deelnemer
archive.description: Remove from active participation without deleting historical boekingen.

onGrPeriodClose.description: When the GR period closes, materialise a balanced GLTransaction in each deelnemer's administration where administrationId is set. Idempotency key: (grAdministrationId, deelnemerId, periodId) prevents re-posting on re-run of GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.
onGrPeriodClose.condition: administrationId IS NOT NULL AND lifecycleState = 'active'

aandeelSumCheck.description: Computes the sum of aandeel across all actief deelnemers. Surfaces a non-blocking warning in the Consolidated view when the result differs from 1.0 per REQ-GRC-004 and design Risk 2.

GRVerdeelsleutel.title: GR Verdeelsleutel
GRVerdeelsleutel.description: An apportionment rule linking a cost-cluster (set of accountNumbers) to a per-deelnemer split method. Multiple verdeelsleutels MAY apply to the same cost cluster, sequenced by lineNumber per REQ-GRC-002.

sleutelNaam.description: Human-readable name of this apportionment rule.

costClusterAccountNumbers.description: Array of Account.accountNumber strings identifying the cost cluster this verdeelsleutel applies to.

verdelingsType.description: Apportionment method. vast-percentage uses fixed per-deelnemer percentages in parameters; inwoner-aantal weights by population count; gewogen-oppervlak by weighted surface area; custom-formula accepts free-form parameters JSON.

parameters.description: Per-deelnemer split parameters validated against verdelingsType. For vast-percentage: object keyed by GRDeelnemer.id with values summing to 1.0. For custom-formula: arbitrary JSON.

lineNumber.description: Sequence number controlling the order in which multiple verdeelsleutels for the same cost cluster are applied.

doorbelastingPerDeelnemer.description: Per-deelnemer doorbelasting aggregation: applies this verdeelsleutel to GLLines whose accountNumber is in costClusterAccountNumbers (excluding eliminated lines). Produces doorbelasting bedrag per deelnemer per cost cluster per REQ-GRC-004.

join.condition: GLLine.accountNumber IN costClusterAccountNumbers AND GLLine.eliminationFlag = false

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

esaClassifier.description: ESA 2010 (European System of Accounts) sector classifier. Drives EMU-saldo computation's sector grouping per REQ-EMU-002. S.1311 = centrale overheid, S.1312 = deelstaatoverheid (N/A in NL), S.1313 = lokale overheid (gemeente/provincie/waterschap), S.1314 = wettelijke sociale verzekering. S.11–S.15/S.2 are non-government sectors per ESA 2010.

bbvVariant.description: BBV regulatory variant under which this account is interpreted. 'waterschap' activates the BBVW (BBV-Waterschappen) framework per REQ-WSB-001.

retention.description: Chart-of-accounts records are kept indefinitely per Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 § 5.1.1 (begroting, jaarrekening, rekeningschema).

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

emuSaldoByQuarter.description: Quarterly EMU-saldo (debit minus credit) grouped by ESA-2010 sector for a given quarter, riding the IV3-base quarterly data per REQ-EMU-003. Filters GLLine rows by period and respects per-line emuInclusionRule (included|partial only; excluded lines are omitted). Partial lines count at 50% contribution. If the declarative engine cannot express the combined multi-sector + emuInclusionRule filter, the guard OCA\Shillinq\Guard\EmuCalculator::computeQuarterlySaldo is invoked per ADR-031 exception path.

emuSaldoByYear.description: Annual EMU-saldo and EMU-schuld from the closed jaarrekening per REQ-EMU-003. Filters all closed-year GLLine rows, groups by ESA-2010 sector, and respects emuInclusionRule. EMU-schuld is derived as the cumulative net liability position across S.13 sectors. Same guard fallback as quarterly per ADR-031.

daysUntilRetention.description: Account records are kept indefinitely (disposition: keep_indefinite per selectielijst:5.1.1). This field always returns null for Account objects.

emuAggregationHash.description: Stable SHA-256 hash of the contributing GL line IDs + esaClassifier state + applied emuInclusionRule values for the last EMU computation. Same inputs always produce the same hash, enabling audit-trail reproducibility per REQ-EMU-005.

RetentionRule.title: Bewaartermijn
RetentionRule.description: Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 retention rule. Declares the statutory retention obligation for a record category per Selectielijst code. Seeded from selectielijst-gemeenten-2020.json; operators MAY add administration-scoped overrides above the statutory minimum per REQ-ARC-004.

daysUntilRetention.description: Days until this retention rule expires. Null when effectiveTo is absent (rules without an end date).

nearing-retention.title: Bewaartermijnen verlopen binnenkort
nearing-retention.description: Count of records nearing retention disposition within THRESHOLD_DAYS (default 90). Surfaced on the Bewaartermijnen dashboard per REQ-ARC-008.

archivist.description: Full access to view, create, and override retention rules.

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

description.description: Plain-Dutch description of the record category covered by this rule.
description.example: Dagelijkse financiële verantwoording (facturen, betalingen, dagboeken, bankafschriften)

recordCategory.description: High-level category of records covered by this rule.

retentionYears.description: Absolute retention period in years from record creation date. Mutually exclusive with retentionTrigger.

retentionTrigger.description: Relative retention expression (e.g. '10 years after vaststellingDate'). Mutually exclusive with retentionYears.

disposition.description: Action taken when the retention period expires.

legalBasis.description: Citation of the legal basis: Archiefwet article + Selectielijst paragraph.

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which this rule is valid.

effectiveTo.description: Date until which this rule is valid. Absent means the rule has no end date.

customRetentionYears.description: Operator-defined extension of the statutory retention period (archiefverordening override). MUST be >= retentionYears — operators may extend retention but NEVER shorten below the Archiefwet floor (REQ-ARC-004).

x-openregister-validation.message: customRetentionYears MUST be >= retentionYears. Operators may extend retention but not shorten it below the statutory minimum (Archiefwet 1995 + REQ-ARC-004).

administrationId.description: Administration identifier for per-administration override rules (archiefverordening scope). Absent on seeded default rules which apply to all administrations.

source.description: Origin: 'seeded' for Selectielijst defaults, 'operator-edited' for administration-specific overrides.

BalanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
BalanceSheet.description: Financial statement showing assets, liabilities, and equity at a fiscal-period snapshot. Status lifecycle: draft → final → published. Totals are computed via x-openregister-aggregations from GL entries grouped by Account.accountType per REQ-FS-004.

reportDate.description: Snapshot date of the balance sheet (typically fiscal-year-end).

totalAssets.description: Computed total assets in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.

totalLiabilities.description: Computed total liabilities in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.

totalEquity.description: Computed total equity in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.

isBalanced.description: Computed flag: totalAssets = totalLiabilities + totalEquity. Surfaced with diagnostic when false.

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the balance sheet.

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this balance sheet covers.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this balance sheet belongs to.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Balance sheet under preparation; GL entries may still be posted.

final.label: Final
final.description: GL period closed; all entries posted; aggregations computed and verified.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable — no further edits.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per administration retention policy.

finalise.label: Finalise balance sheet
finalise.description: Operator or scheduled workflow closes fiscal period. Triggers balance-sheet aggregation (REQ-FS-004).

publish.label: Publish balance sheet
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive balance sheet
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per administration retention policy.

onFinalise.description: Fire balance-sheet aggregation to populate totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity, and isBalanced from GL entries (REQ-FS-004). Also triggers TrialBalance finalisation for the same fiscalYearId and administrationId.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

balanceSheetTotals.description: Computes totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity from GLLine entries grouped by Account.accountType for the fiscal period. Satisfies REQ-FS-004. No BalanceSheetService — pure declarative aggregation per ADR-031.

isBalanced.diagnostic: Balance-sheet equation violated: assets({{totalAssets}}) ≠ liabilities({{totalLiabilities}}) + equity({{totalEquity}})

TrialBalance.title: Trial Balance
TrialBalance.description: Listing of all GL accounts with debit/credit balances for period verification. isBalanced flag (totalDebits = totalCredits) computed via aggregation per REQ-FS-005. No TrialBalanceService.

reportDate.description: Snapshot date of the trial balance (typically fiscal-year-end).

totalDebits.description: Sum of all debit balances across all accounts for the fiscal period.

totalCredits.description: Sum of all credit balances across all accounts for the fiscal period.

isBalanced.description: Computed flag: totalDebits = totalCredits. Surfaced with diagnostic when false.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the trial balance.

preparedBy.description: Actor who prepared or verified the trial balance (audit trail).

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this trial balance covers.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this trial balance belongs to.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Trial balance under preparation; GL entries may still be posted.

verified.label: Verified
verified.description: Aggregation run; isBalanced confirmed true by bookkeeper.

final.label: Final
final.description: GL period closed; all entries posted; trial balance verified and locked.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per administration retention policy.

verify.label: Run trial-balance verification
verify.description: Triggers trial-balance aggregation (REQ-FS-005); sets isBalanced. Bookkeeper confirms result.

finalise.label: Finalise trial balance
finalise.description: Operator or scheduled workflow closes fiscal period. Also triggered by BalanceSheet finalise hook.

publish.label: Publish trial balance
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive trial balance
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per administration retention policy.

onVerify.description: Fire trial-balance aggregation to populate totalDebits, totalCredits, and isBalanced. Surfaces diagnostic when not balanced per REQ-FS-005.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

trialBalanceTotals.description: Computes totalDebits, totalCredits, and isBalanced flag from GLLine entries for the fiscal period. Satisfies REQ-FS-005 verification check. No TrialBalanceService — pure declarative aggregation per ADR-031.

isBalanced.diagnostic: Trial balance is not balanced: debits({{totalDebits}}) ≠ credits({{totalCredits}}), discrepancy = {{totalDebits - totalCredits}}

trialBalanceByAccount.description: Per-account trial balance listing: accountNumber, name, accountType, totalDebits, totalCredits per REQ-FS-005 for the fiscal period.

ConsolidationGroup.title: Consolidation Group
ConsolidationGroup.description: A group of organizations consolidated together for financial reporting across multiple administrations. Holds the consolidation method (full/proportional/equity per IFRS 10/11/12) and inter-company elimination rules. Consumed by ConsolidatedReport per REQ-FS-006.

name.description: Human-readable name of the consolidation group.

parentOrganizationId.description: FK to the parent organization if part of a larger group.

eliminationRules.description: Inter-company elimination rules. Simple patterns (offset-by-FK, percentage-based) are declarative; complex custom rules defined by admin. Consumed by OR consolidation engine or ConsolidationGuard per ADR-031 exception.

intercompanySales.description: Eliminate inter-company sales between group members

administrationIds.description: FKs to Administration records being consolidated into this group.

active.label: Active
active.description: Consolidation group is in use for consolidated reporting.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Consolidation group temporarily suspended; no new consolidated reports.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical group; remains queryable but no new consolidated reports.

reactivate.label: Reactivate group
reactivate.description: Restore consolidation group to active use.

archive.label: Archive group
archive.description: Archive consolidation group for historical reference.

ConsolidatedReport.title: Consolidated Report
ConsolidatedReport.description: Aggregated financial report combining data from multiple administrations with consolidation method and inter-company elimination tracking per REQ-FS-006. Lifecycle draft → final → published consumes OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

reportNumber.description: Unique identifier for the consolidated report.

consolidationGroupId.description: FK to the ConsolidationGroup defining which organizations are consolidated.

consolidationMethod.description: Method used for this consolidated report (full/proportional/equity per IFRS 10/11/12).

eliminationsApplied.description: Whether inter-company eliminations have been posted for this report.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the consolidated report.

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this consolidated report covers.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Consolidated report under preparation. Individual administration statements may still be in draft.

final.label: Final
final.description: All member administrations finalised; consolidation and eliminations applied; report locked.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per group retention policy.

finalise.label: Finalise consolidated report
finalise.description: Applies consolidation workflow and inter-company eliminations per ConsolidationGroup.eliminationRules. Consumed via OR consolidation extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031 exception.

publish.label: Publish consolidated report
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive consolidated report
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per group retention policy.

onFinalise.description: Executes consolidation workflow via OR consolidation extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard. Sets eliminationsApplied=true after inter-company eliminations. Records audit trail of elimination amounts per REQ-FS-006.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly IV3 (Informatie voor Derden) export to CBS for Dutch decentralised government administrations. Lifecycle covers generation, validation, submission, and CBS acceptance/rejection.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this export belongs to.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year of the IV3 reporting period (e.g. 2026).

iv3Version.description: CBS IV3-bestand specification version used for this export (e.g. '2026.1').

buckets.description: Aggregated GL values keyed by IV3 bucket code (sum of debit minus credit per bucket for closed-period postings). Derived via x-openregister-aggregations — do not set directly.

xmlAttachmentUri.description: Docudesk URI of the generated CBS IV3 XML file.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the IV3 export.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was generated.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was submitted to CBS.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when CBS accepted the export.

cbsMessageId.description: CBS-side message identifier returned on submission.

correctionOf.description: FK to a prior Iv3Export.id that this export supersedes (correction flow).

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: Export created and XML artifact generated. Awaiting operator validation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: XML validated against the CBS IV3 schema. Ready for operator submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3. Awaiting CBS acknowledgement.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: CBS accepted the export. Terminal state unless a correction is filed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: CBS rejected the export. Operator must correct and re-validate.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: A correction export (with correctionOf set) supersedes this one.

retention.description: IV3 verantwoording-naar-derden records retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

validate.label: Validate XML
validate.description: Operator validates the generated XML against the CBS IV3 schema.

submit.label: Submit to CBS
submit.description: Operator submits the validated export to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3.

accept.label: CBS Accepted
accept.description: CBS accepted the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

reject.label: CBS Rejected
reject.description: CBS rejected the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

revalidate.label: Re-validate after fix
revalidate.description: Operator re-validates after correcting the rejection reason.

correct.label: File correction
correct.description: Operator files a corrected export (sets correctionOf on the new Iv3Export).

buckets.description: Sum of (debit - credit) per IV3 bucket code over closed-period GLLine rows for this export's administrationId + quarter. Joins GLLine → Account → BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket (T3 bbv-compliance). Filters to periodIds closed per T2 period-close boundaries.

quarterly-cbs-submission.name: IV3 quarterly CBS submission
quarterly-cbs-submission.description: Generates and submits IV3 exports for all closed gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations on a quarterly schedule.

BBVProgramma.title: BBV Programma
BBVProgramma.description: A BBV programma-indeling entry grouping GL postings by taakveld (gemeente/provincie) or kostentoedeling (waterschap). The programmaStructure discriminator controls which classification hierarchy is used per REQ-WSB-002.

code.description: Unique programma code within the administration (e.g. 'watersysteembeheer', 'taakveld-0.1').

beschrijving.description: Optional operator-authored description of this programma.
beschrijving.example: Beheer van het watersysteem inclusief veiligheid en kwaliteit.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this programma. Scopes uniqueness of code.

programmaStructure.description: Discriminator that controls the classification hierarchy used at aggregation / rollup time. 'kostentoedeling' is the BBVW-canonical structure for waterschappen per REQ-WSB-002.

bbvVariant.description: BBV regulatory variant under which this programma is interpreted per REQ-WSB-001.

parentCode.description: FK to the parent BBVProgramma.code for hierarchical programma navigation.

postingsByProgramma.description: Aggregates GL debit/credit totals per programma code, honouring the programmaStructure discriminator. When programmaStructure is 'kostentoedeling', groups by kostentoedeling cluster; when 'taakveld', groups by taakveld code.

parentProgramma.description: Self-relation for hierarchical programma navigation (hoofdprogramma → sub-programma).

WaterschapHeffingPosting.title: Waterschap Heffing Posting
WaterschapHeffingPosting.description: Sector-specific belasting posting for the three waterschapsbelastingen: watersysteemheffing, zuiveringsheffing, and verontreinigingsheffing. On transition to 'posted', materialises a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1 REQ-GL-001 with sourceReference back to this posting. Does NOT carry its own ledger lines per design D3.

heffingType.description: Type of waterschap belasting per REQ-WSB-004.

tariefGrondslag.description: Canonical grondslag for the tarief computation (e.g. 'vervuilingseenheden', 'oppervlakte-m2', 'inwonerequivalenten').

tarief.description: Applied tarief per grondslag-eenheid in EUR.

aanslagBedrag.description: Total aanslag amount in EUR (tarief × grondslag-quantity). This amount is materialised into a balanced GLTransaction on post.

journalEntryId.description: FK to the materialised GLTransaction.id. Set by the lifecycle engine on transition to 'posted'. Null until posted.

emuExclusionRule.description: Controls whether this posting contributes to the waterschap EMU-saldo per REQ-WSB-005 and the EMU-bijlage waterschappen handleiding 2026. 'excluded' = posting is omitted from the EMU-saldo aggregation; 'partial' = operator-defined partial inclusion.

administrationId.description: FK to the waterschap Administration owning this heffing posting.

debitAccountNumber.description: Account to debit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. receivable account for the heffing aanslag).

creditAccountNumber.description: Account to credit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. revenue account for the heffing type).

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the heffing posting.

description.description: Optional operator-authored description or reference number.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Heffing posting is being prepared; no GL impact yet.

posted.label: Geboekt
posted.description: Posting is confirmed; a balanced 2-line GLTransaction has been materialised per REQ-GL-001.

reversed.label: Gestorneerd
reversed.description: Posting has been reversed; a contra-GLTransaction has been materialised.

post.label: Boek aanslag
post.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction (debit receivable, credit revenue) for the aanslagBedrag and set journalEntryId.

reverse.label: Storneer aanslag
reverse.description: Materialise a contra-GLTransaction to reverse the original posting.

onPost.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1 REQ-GL-001. Debit debitAccountNumber for aanslagBedrag, credit creditAccountNumber for aanslagBedrag. Set sourceReference to WaterschapHeffingPosting.id. Write journalEntryId FK back to this record. Idempotency key: (administrationId, id) prevents re-posting on repair-step re-run.

totalByHeffingType.description: Total aanslag bedrag per heffingType for the administration, excluding reversed postings. Used by the waterschapsbelastingen index page.

emuIncludedTotal.description: Total aanslag bedrag for postings included in the EMU-saldo computation (emuExclusionRule != 'excluded'). Read by the bookkeeping-emu-reporting sibling spec.

FixedAsset.title: Fixed Asset
FixedAsset.description: A capitalised tangible or intangible business asset with declarative depreciation rules, parallel commercial/fiscal streams, and a managed lifecycle (proposed → active → disposed → archived). Depreciation values are derived on demand — no materialised schedule table.

assetNumber.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration (e.g. FA-0001).

name.description: Human-readable asset name (e.g. Dell laptop XPS-15).

acquisitionCost.description: Original cost in the administration's base currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the acquisition cost.

residualValue.description: Estimated salvage value at end of useful life.

depreciationMethod.description: Depreciation method applied to this asset.

degressiveRate.description: Annual declining-balance percentage when depreciationMethod = degressive (e.g. 0.20 for 20%). Required when method is degressive.

commercialRate.description: Annual depreciation rate for commercial books (IFRS / Dutch GAAP). When set together with fiscalRate, two parallel streams are produced.

fiscalRate.description: Annual depreciation rate for fiscal books (Wet IB / Wet VPB). May differ from commercialRate (e.g. Wet IB 20% cap rule).

assetAccountNumber.description: FK to the Account carrying the asset's gross value (e.g. 0220).

accumulatedDepAccountNumber.description: FK to the contra Account for accumulated depreciation (e.g. 0225).

depreciationExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to the P&L Account for the depreciation expense charge (e.g. 4500).

disposalDate.description: Date the asset was disposed of (sale, scrap, donation). Set when lifecycleState transitions to disposed.

disposalAccountingTreatment.description: Accounting treatment on disposal. Required when disposalDate is set.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the asset.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this asset. Scopes uniqueness of assetNumber.

monthlyDepreciation.description: Monthly depreciation charge for the current period under the linear method. Zero when depreciationMethod = none.

currentBookValue.description: Current net book value. Equals acquisitionCost minus accumulated depreciation calculated from acquisitionDate to today. For none-method assets this always equals acquisitionCost.
currentBookValue.expression: (depreciationMethod == 'none') ? acquisitionCost : max(residualValue, acquisitionCost - ((acquisitionCost - residualValue) / usefulLifeMonths) * monthsElapsed(@self.acquisitionDate))

commercialBookValue.description: Net book value under the commercial depreciation stream (IFRS / Dutch GAAP). Only meaningful when commercialRate is set.

fiscalBookValue.description: Net book value under the fiscal depreciation stream (Wet IB / Wet VPB). Only meaningful when fiscalRate is set.

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: Asset is under consideration for capitalisation. Not yet active on the balance sheet.

active.label: Active
active.description: Asset is capitalised and subject to periodic depreciation postings.

disposed.label: Disposed
disposed.description: Asset has been sold, scrapped, donated, or transferred. A closing JournalEntry has been emitted.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Asset record is retained for historical reference only. No further postings or edits.

activate.label: Activate asset
activate.description: Capitalise the asset and start the depreciation clock.

dispose.label: Dispose asset
dispose.description: Dispose of the asset and emit a closing JournalEntry (credits asset account for gross value, debits accumulated depreciation, posts gain/loss based on disposalAccountingTreatment and disposal proceeds).

action.description: Emits a balanced JournalEntry zeroing the asset account and accumulated depreciation, and posting any gain or loss to the configured P&L account based on disposalAccountingTreatment.

archive.label: Archive asset
archive.description: Move disposed asset to historical archive.

rejectProposal.label: Reject proposal
rejectProposal.description: Reject the asset proposal without capitalising it.

assetAccount.description: Balance-sheet account carrying the asset's gross value.

depreciationExpenseAccount.description: P&L account for the periodic depreciation expense charge.

totalByCategory.description: Number of active assets per assetCategory.

totalAcquisitionCost.description: Total gross acquisition cost of all active assets.

KorThreshold.title: KOR Threshold
KorThreshold.description: Versioned statutory KOR threshold record per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1. Seeded from kor-thresholds-2026.json; multiple records with non-overlapping effectiveFrom/effectiveTo windows support future statutory revisions per REQ-KOR-003.

thresholdAmount.description: Statutory KOR omzetdrempel in EUR (currently €20,000 per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1).

warningPercentage.description: Percentage of thresholdAmount at which the threshold-warning notification fires (default 80).

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this threshold record applies to.

citation.description: Statutory citation for this threshold value.

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which this threshold record is effective.

effectiveTo.description: Date after which this threshold is superseded. Null means currently in force.

KorRegime.title: KOR Regime
KorRegime.description: KOR (Kleine Ondernemersregeling) opt-in/opt-out regime record per administrationId and calendar year. Tracks the 5-state lifecycle, YTD revenue (declarative calculation over Invoice T2), threshold, and generates a pending JournalEntry on opt-out per REQ-KOR-006. Visibility restricted to mkb/zzp administration types per REQ-KOR-001.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this KOR regime record.

state.description: Current KOR lifecycle state per REQ-KOR-002.

currentCalendarYear.description: Calendar year tracked by ytdRevenue. KOR applies per calendar year (Wet OB 1968 art. 25).

ytdRevenue.description: Year-to-date revenue within currentCalendarYear, derived via x-openregister-calculations from Invoice (T2 AR sub-ledger). Do not set directly.

thresholdAmount.description: Active KOR omzetdrempel for currentCalendarYear; read from KorThreshold seed. Default €20,000.

warningPercentage.description: Warning fires at warningPercentage % of thresholdAmount; read from KorThreshold seed. Default 80.

exceededAt.description: Date when ytdRevenue first crossed the full threshold.

notes.description: Operator-authored context (e.g. 'Opt-out due to ICP-omzet uitsluiting').

retention.description: KOR financial records retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 (financiële administratie bewaarplicht).

outside.label: Buiten KOR
outside.description: Administration is not enrolled in KOR. No BTW exemption on outputs.

opted-in.label: KOR actief
opted-in.description: Administration is enrolled in KOR. BTW-vrijstelling op outputs geldt.

threshold-warning.label: Drempelwaarschuwing (80%)
threshold-warning.description: YTD revenue has reached 80% of the omzetdrempel. Operator should monitor closely.

threshold-exceeded.label: Drempel overschreden (100%)
threshold-exceeded.description: YTD revenue has reached or exceeded the omzetdrempel. Opt-out required.

opted-out.label: Buiten KOR (opt-out)
opted-out.description: Administration has opted out of KOR. 3-year re-entry lock-out applies per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 3.

optIn.label: Opt in bij KOR
optIn.description: Operator opts the administration into KOR for the current calendar year. Belastingdienst notification is the operator's responsibility.

warnThreshold.label: Drempelwaarschuwing
warnThreshold.description: Auto-transitions when ytdRevenue reaches warningPercentage % of thresholdAmount (default 80% = €16,000 on €20,000 threshold). Calculation-crossing trigger per ADR-031.

exceedThreshold.label: Drempel overschreden
exceedThreshold.description: Auto-transitions when ytdRevenue reaches or exceeds thresholdAmount. Calculation-crossing trigger per ADR-031.

yearRollover.label: Jaar-rollover
yearRollover.description: Reverts threshold-warning to opted-in on Jan 1 when ytdRevenue resets to zero for the new calendar year.

optOutFromExceeded.label: Opt out (drempel)
optOutFromExceeded.description: Administration opts out following threshold exceedance. Generates a pending JournalEntry for regime-change BTW reclamation reversal.

returnToOutside.label: Terug buiten KOR
returnToOutside.description: After the 3-year re-entry lock-out per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 3, operator may return to outside state.

onOptOut.description: On threshold-exceeded → opted-out: create a JournalEntry template for BTW reclamation reversal. MUST ship in state: pending per REQ-KOR-006 safety constraint. Operator + accountant approval required before posting.

data.description: KOR-regimewijziging: terugdraaien vrijgestelde BTW op outputs (art. 15 lid 2 Wet OB 1968). Goedkeuring vereist van operator en accountant alvorens boeking.

ytdRevenue.description: Year-to-date revenue sum from Invoice (T2 AR sub-ledger) for this administrationId within currentCalendarYear. Excludes cancelled invoices and credit notes. Per REQ-KOR-004; ADR-031 exception path: if OR's calculation engine cannot express the period-filter aggregation, a thin single-method KorThresholdGuard::currentYtdRevenue() guard (~30 LOC) is permitted.

onOptIn.description: Notify vat-administrator when KOR is activated for the administration.
onOptIn.title: KOR geactiveerd
onOptIn.message: KOR-vrijstelling is geactiveerd voor administratie @self.administrationId voor jaar @self.currentCalendarYear.

onThresholdWarning.description: Notify vat-administrator when YTD revenue reaches the warning threshold (80%).
onThresholdWarning.title: KOR-drempelwaarschuwing
onThresholdWarning.message: KOR-omzet bedraagt €@self.ytdRevenue (@self.ytdRevenue / @self.thresholdAmount * 100% van de drempel). Actie aanbevolen.

onThresholdExceeded.description: Notify vat-administrator when YTD revenue reaches or exceeds the full KOR threshold.
onThresholdExceeded.title: KOR-drempel overschreden
onThresholdExceeded.message: KOR-omzetdrempel van €@self.thresholdAmount is overschreden (ytdRevenue: €@self.ytdRevenue). Opt-out vereist; er wordt een journaalpost aangemaakt ter beoordeling.

onOptOut.description: Notify vat-administrator when the administration opts out of KOR.
onOptOut.title: KOR opt-out
onOptOut.message: Administratie @self.administrationId heeft de KOR verlaten. Controleer de aangemaakte journaalpost (state: pending) voor BTW-correcties.

korStatus.title: KOR-status
korStatus.description: KOR threshold tracker showing YTD revenue progress bar, regime state, and threshold indicators for mkb/zzp administrations.

TaxRegimeConfiguration.title: Tax Regime Configuration
TaxRegimeConfiguration.description: ZZP tax regime parameters including fiscal year, income tax rate, statutory allowances, filing deadline, and GL account to statutory category mapping rules. Configuration-driven per ADR-031 and REQ-TAX-002; no hardcoded PHP mapping constants.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this configuration applies to.

regimeType.description: Tax regime type. ZZP sole-trader is the primary T3 scope; partnership and cv deferred to future tiers.

incomeTaxRate.description: Marginal income tax rate as a decimal (e.g. 0.25 for 25%). Statutory rate for the given fiscal year.

generalAllowance.description: General statutory allowance in EUR (algemene heffingskorting equivalent).

soleTraderAllowance.description: Sole trader deduction in EUR (zelfstandigenaftrek) if applicable.

filingDeadline.description: Statutory filing deadline for this fiscal year (e.g. 2027-04-20 for FY2026).

categoryMappingRules.description: JSON object mapping GL account ranges or specific accounts to statutory tax categories. Keys are account ranges (e.g. '4000-4099') or individual accounts (e.g. '4150'); values are category names. Range-based keys use dash notation; individual account keys take precedence over ranges (per REQ-TAX-005).

allowanceAmounts.description: Per-category allowance overrides (e.g. { 'business-expenses': 5000 }) for statutory caps.

versionId.description: Semantic version identifier enabling retroactive recalculation when rules change (e.g. 'zzp-2026-v1').

status.description: Lifecycle status of this configuration version.

active.label: Active
active.description: Configuration in use for new TaxSummaryReport aggregations and TaxEstimate projections.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Configuration retired but retained for historical estimate audit trail.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: Replaced by a newer configuration version. Prior TaxEstimate records using this version remain immutable.

archive.label: Archive configuration
archive.description: Retire this configuration; historical records remain queryable.

supersede.label: Supersede configuration
supersede.description: Mark as superseded when a new configuration version takes effect.

activeConfigurationsByYear.description: Count of active TaxRegimeConfiguration records per fiscal year. Surfaced on Tax Filing Prep dashboard.

TaxSummaryReport.title: Tax Summary Report
TaxSummaryReport.description: GL-aggregated income and expense summary by statutory tax category and fiscal period. Materialized from GLLine transactions grouped by (administrationId, fiscalYear, reportingPeriod, taxCategory) per REQ-TAX-003. No parallel tax table; aggregation is the source of truth per ADR-031 D1.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this report belongs to.

reportingPeriod.description: Reporting granularity: annual, quarterly, or monthly.

glTransactionCount.description: Count of GLLine transactions included in this aggregation for audit trail sanity checks.

grossAmount.description: Sum of GLLine amounts for this category and period in EUR.

deductionsAmount.description: Statutory deductions or allowances applicable to this category (EUR).

netAmount.description: grossAmount minus deductionsAmount (EUR). Basis for TaxEstimate income calculation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code.

snapshotDate.description: Date the aggregation was computed. Makes GL posting lag explicit for operators.

configurationVersionId.description: FK to TaxRegimeConfiguration.versionId used for the GL account to category mapping. Enables retroactive recalculation if mapping rules change.

status.description: Draft until operator finalizes; amended when a GL repost changes the aggregated amounts.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Aggregation in progress or awaiting operator review. Updated automatically on each GL posting.

finalized.label: Finalized
finalized.description: Operator has confirmed the summary for the period.

amended.label: Amended
amended.description: A GL repost has changed the amounts after finalization. Audit trail records old and new values.

finalize.label: Finalize report
finalize.description: Operator confirms the tax summary for filing preparation.

amend.label: Mark as amended
amend.description: Triggered automatically when a GL repost changes amounts after finalization.

redraft.label: Return to draft
redraft.description: Reset to draft for re-review after amendment.

onGlLinePosted.description: When a GLLine posts, the aggregation engine applies TaxRegimeConfiguration.categoryMappingRules to the accountNumber, resolves the taxCategory, and upserts the TaxSummaryReport row for (administrationId, fiscalYear, reportingPeriod, taxCategory). Updates grossAmount, deductionsAmount, netAmount, glTransactionCount, and snapshotDate. Per REQ-TAX-007.

incomeByCategory.description: Sum of grossAmount per taxCategory for a given administrationId and fiscalYear. Drives Tax Filing Prep dashboard table widget and TaxEstimate YTD calculation.

finalizedSummaryCount.description: Count of finalized TaxSummaryReport rows. Surfaced as the 'tax summaries ready' KPI on Tax Filing Prep dashboard per REQ-TAX-006.

TaxEstimate.title: Tax Estimate
TaxEstimate.description: Real-time annual income tax (IB) liability projection for Dutch ZZP freelancers. Materialized view consuming GL year-to-date snapshot and TaxRegimeConfiguration per REQ-TAX-004 and ADR-031 D3. Computed on read or scheduled refresh; records calculation inputs for audit trail per D5.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this estimate belongs to.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year for which the estimate projects annual liability.

snapshotDate.description: Date through which GL transactions are included in the YTD calculation. Operators see 'estimate as of [date]' for GL lag awareness per REQ-TAX-009.

configurationVersionId.description: FK to TaxRegimeConfiguration.versionId used for this calculation. Enables retroactive comparison when rules change per D5.

glTransactionCount.description: Count of GL transactions included in the YTD calculation. Sanity check for GL completeness per REQ-TAX-009.

ytdTaxableIncome.description: YTD income aggregated from GLLine per categoryMappingRules income categories (EUR).

ytdTaxableExpenses.description: YTD deductible expenses aggregated from GLLine per categoryMappingRules expense categories (EUR).

estimatedAnnualIncome.description: Projected annual income: ytdTaxableIncome × (12 / months-elapsed). Months elapsed computed from snapshotDate and fiscalYear start per REQ-TAX-008.

estimatedTaxableIncome.description: estimatedAnnualNetIncome after statutory allowances from TaxRegimeConfiguration (generalAllowance, soleTraderAllowance, allowanceAmounts) (EUR).

witholdingCredits.description: Accumulated withheld tax or advance payments deducted from estimated liability (EUR). May be negative = refund due.

estimatedNetLiability.description: estimatedIncomeTax minus witholdingCredits (EUR). Negative value indicates a refund is due.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code.

status.description: Current = most recent estimate for this administrationId + fiscalYear. Superseded = a newer estimate has been computed.

current.label: Current
current.description: Most recent annual tax liability estimate for this administration and fiscal year.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: An updated estimate has been computed. Record retained for audit trail and liability delta comparison per REQ-TAX-004.

supersede.label: Supersede estimate
supersede.description: Triggered when a new TaxEstimate is computed for the same administrationId + fiscalYear.

onGlLinePosted.description: When a GLLine posts, amends, or reverses for an income/expense account, the current TaxEstimate for (administrationId, fiscalYear) is transitioned to 'superseded' and a new estimate is computed. Implements REQ-TAX-007 and REQ-TAX-012 recalculation trigger. Idempotency: only one estimate per (administrationId, fiscalYear, snapshotDate) remains 'current'.

ytdByCategory.description: YTD income and expense totals per administrationId and fiscalYear through snapshotDate. Drives TaxEstimate materialized-view computation: YTD sums from TaxSummaryReport grouped by income vs expense categories, then projected to annual using months-elapsed formula per REQ-TAX-008.

currentEstimateByYear.description: Most recent current TaxEstimate per administrationId and fiscalYear. Surfaced as 'Estimated annual liability' KPI on Tax Filing Prep dashboard per REQ-TAX-006.

CostCenter.title: Cost Center
CostCenter.description: An analytical cost center (kostenplaats) for tracking, allocating, and analysing departmental or functional expenses. Declared as an OR-managed register per REQ-CC-001 and REQ-CC-002. Hierarchy is navigable via the parentCode self-relation.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration per REQ-CC-002.

description.description: Operator-readable description of the cost center per REQ-CPA-104.

status.description: Convenience alias of lifecycleState for active/inactive integrations per REQ-CPA-104.

budget.description: Operator-set baseline budget in integer cents (e.g. 10000000 = €100.000,00) per REQ-CPA-104. Used as input to allocatedBudget rollup (REQ-CPA-107).

spentToDate.description: Derived via x-openregister-aggregations: sum of GLLine.amount where costCenterCode = @self.code AND side = 'debit' per REQ-CPA-106. Read-only.

allocatedBudget.description: Derived via x-openregister-calculations: budget + sum(children.allocatedBudget) recursively per REQ-CPA-107. Read-only.

organizationId.description: FK to the Organization owning this cost center per REQ-CPA-104.

parentCode.description: FK to parent CostCenter.code for hierarchy navigation via x-openregister-relations self-relation per REQ-CC-002.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user id of the cost-center owner.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state mirroring Account.lifecycleState per REQ-CoA-005 and REQ-CC-002.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this cost center.

active.label: Active
active.description: Usable for GL line dimension tagging.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable but rejected as target of new GL line dimension tags.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only; no new dimension tags.

block.label: Block cost center
block.description: Prevent new GL line tagging against this cost center.

unblock.label: Unblock cost center
unblock.description: Re-enable GL line tagging against this cost center.

archive.label: Archive cost center
archive.description: Move to historical archive; GL lines with this code remain queryable.

parentCostCenter.description: Self-relation enabling hierarchical cost-center navigation per REQ-CC-002.

segmentPnl.description: Segment P&L for this cost center: sum of GLLine amounts whose costCenterCode equals this record's code, including child cost centers rolled up via parentCode. Consumed by the CostCenter detail page per REQ-CC-005.

spentToDate.description: Sum of GL debit postings tagged to this cost center (recursive over descendant cost centers reached via parentCode self-relation) per REQ-CPA-106. Excludes eliminated intercompany lines.

allocatedBudget.description: Roll-up budget per REQ-CPA-107: this cost center's own budget plus the allocatedBudget of every child cost center reached via the parentCode self-relation (recursive descent). Leaves return their own budget; non-leaves return budget + sum(children.allocatedBudget).

KostenDrager.title: Kostendrager
KostenDrager.description: An analytical cost unit (kostendrager / cost object) for tracking costs per product, service, or cost bearer per Dutch GAAP. Same shape as CostCenter; the distinction is semantic per REQ-CC-002. Hierarchy navigable via parentCode self-relation.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration per REQ-CC-002.

parentCode.description: FK to parent KostenDrager.code for hierarchy navigation per REQ-CC-002.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user id of the kostendrager owner.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state per REQ-CC-002.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this kostendrager.

active.label: Active
active.description: Usable for GL line dimension tagging.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable but rejected as target of new GL line tags.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only; no new dimension tags.

block.label: Block kostendrager
block.description: Prevent new GL line tagging against this kostendrager.

unblock.label: Unblock kostendrager
unblock.description: Re-enable GL line tagging against this kostendrager.

archive.label: Archive kostendrager
archive.description: Move to historical archive.

parentKostenDrager.description: Self-relation enabling hierarchical kostendrager navigation per REQ-CC-002.

segmentPnl.description: Segment P&L for this kostendrager: sum of GLLine amounts whose kostenDragerCode equals this record's code per REQ-CC-005.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Consultancy project with RJ 270 / IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion revenue recognition. Lifecycle offerte → active → on-hold → closed → archived.

code.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration per REQ-CC-002.

parentCode.description: FK to parent Project.code for hierarchy navigation per REQ-CC-002.

responsibleUser.description: Nextcloud user id of the project owner.

timeBookingEnabled.description: When true, time bookings may reference this project for WBSO hours-per-project derivation per REQ-CC-007. Non-required; false by default.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state per REQ-CC-002.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this project.

projectNumber.description: Unique project identifier per administration (e.g. PRJ-2026-001).

customerId.description: FK to the customer contact record.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the project.

totalContractValue.description: Total contracted revenue in project currency (operator-set).

totalEstimatedCosts.description: Total estimated costs (operator-set; revised over project life; revision triggers audit-trail entry).

costsIncurredToDate.description: Derived from GL via x-openregister-aggregations: sum of GLLine amounts on expense accounts tagged to this project (REQ-CPA-006).

recognisedRevenue.description: Derived via x-openregister-calculations: RJ 270 / IFRS 15 percentage-of-completion formula (REQ-CPA-007).

billedRevenue.description: Derived from invoices (T2 AR) referencing this project via subLedgerRef.

recognitionMethod.description: Revenue recognition method per RJ 270 / IFRS 15.

recognitionStage.description: Current RJ 270 completion stage (from rj-270-stages.json seed).

percentageComplete.description: Operator-supplied completion percentage for output-based recognition method.

currency.description: ISO 4217 project currency.

closureJustification.description: Operator justification when closing a project with non-zero WIP balance.

wbsoTagId.description: FK to WBSOTag. When set, new Urenregistratie entries under this project auto-inherit this WBSO code (REQ-WBSO-004). Null for non-subsidized projects.

activityCodeId.description: FK to WBSOActivityCode. Combined with wbsoTagId, enables auto-tagging of Urenregistratie entries (REQ-WBSO-004). Null for non-subsidized projects.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Project is in execution; GL postings and hour logging are permitted.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable but rejected as target of new GL line or time-entry tags.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Historical only; remains queryable per 7-year retention rule.

offerte.label: Offerte
offerte.description: Project is at quotation stage; no GL postings yet.

on-hold.label: On hold

Captures the management-accounting view of a project (authorised budget, estimated costs, costs incurred to date, lifecycle) — distinct from the RJ 270 revenue-recognition Project register. Costs and P&L are derived from GL via x-openregister-aggregations; budget rollup via x-openregister-calculations. No PHP service authored per ADR-031.

projectNumber.description: Operator-assigned unique project reference within the administration per REQ-CPA-101.

totalEstimatedCosts.description: Project-manager estimate of total project costs in integer cents per REQ-CPA-101.

costsIncurredToDate.description: Derived via x-openregister-aggregations: sum of GLLine.amount where subLedgerType='cost-project' AND subLedgerRef=@self.id AND Account.accountType='expenses' per REQ-CPA-105. Integer cents. Read-only.

AllocationRule.title: Allocation Rule
AllocationRule.description: A cost-allocation rule declared as schema metadata per ADR-031 (design D2). Stores the rule shape: source pattern, driver, targets, target dimension, and cadence. Per-posting rules fire as x-openregister-lifecycle action on GLTransaction.post; monthly/period-close rules fire via OR ScheduledWorkflow. No AllocationService.allocate() ever runs the rule. Compliance: REQ-CC-004.

sourceAccountPattern.description: Glob or range pattern matching source GL accounts (e.g. 1000-1099 or 4900). Evaluated against GLLine.accountNumber on per-posting rules per REQ-CC-004.

targets.description: At least 2 target entries. For fixed-percentage: percentages MUST sum to 100 (enforced by x-openregister-lifecycle.requires on save per REQ-CC-004). For fixed-amount: amounts specify absolute allocation per target. For volume/headcount: source specifies the reference register or field.

code.description: Target dimension code (FK to CostCenter.code, KostenDrager.code, or Project.code depending on targetDimension).

percentage.description: Allocation percentage for fixed-percentage driver. All targets MUST sum to 100.

amount.description: Fixed allocation amount for fixed-amount driver.

source.description: Reference field or register for volume/headcount driver.

targetDimension.description: Which dimension the targets[].code values refer to per REQ-CC-004.

cadence.description: Execution cadence per REQ-CC-004. per-posting fires on GLTransaction.post lifecycle action; monthly and period-close fire via OR ScheduledWorkflow.

lifecycleState.description: Activation state. Seeded rules ship in paused state per design Seed Data section.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this allocation rule.

active.label: Active
active.description: Rule is evaluated on its cadence. For per-posting: on every GLTransaction.post.

activate.label: Activate rule

archive.label: Archive rule
archive.description: Retire the rule permanently.

monthlyAllocation.description: Evaluates all active AllocationRule records with cadence=monthly against the previous month's posted GLLines per REQ-CC-004 design D2. No PHP AllocationService orchestrates this — the rule body lives in this schema.

periodCloseAllocation.description: Evaluates all active AllocationRule records with cadence=period-close when the fiscal period closes per REQ-CC-004 design D2.

capacityHoursPerWeek.description: Operator-set weekly capacity hours for utilisation calculation. Default 40 per Wet IB (36-hour workweek; operator override allowed).

RateCard.title: Tarievenkaart
RateCard.description: Rate card with per-level hourly rates and effectivity windows. Default templates seeded from rate-card-templates.json (REQ-CPA-005).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this rate card.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency for hourlyRate.

description.description: Optional description of this rate card entry.

RateCardTemplate.title: Rate Card Template
RateCardTemplate.description: Reusable rate-card structure definition for multi-tier billing rates (user / role / project / client / blended). Versioned via RateCardVersion; tier-specific rates declared in RateSchedule. Per-OU isolation (administrationId). REQ-RATE-002.

description.description: Purpose and scope of this rate-card template.

tierStructure.description: Ordered list of rate tiers, highest precedence first (user > role > project > client > blended).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. All rates on schedules tied to this template MUST use this currency.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this template (per-OU isolation; REQ-RATE-002).

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the template.

archive.description: Retire this rate-card template. Existing versions and schedules remain queryable.

reactivate.label: Reactivate template
reactivate.description: Restore an archived template to active state.

RateCardVersion.title: Rate Card Version
RateCardVersion.description: Effective-dated variant of a RateCardTemplate. Multiple concurrent versions per administration are supported, each covering a non-overlapping effective-date window. REQ-RATE-003.

effectiveDate.description: Start date this version is active (inclusive). MUST be >= today at creation time (REQ-RATE-009).

expiryDate.description: End date (inclusive); null = open-ended. Effective-date windows per template MUST NOT overlap (REQ-RATE-003).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this version (per-OU isolation).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Version being prepared; not yet in use for rate lookups.

active.label: Active
active.description: Version is live; rate lookups use schedules tied to this version within its effective-date window.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Version expiryDate has passed; historical only.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Manually retired; no longer in use.

activate.label: Activate version
activate.description: Make this version live for rate lookups. Validates non-overlapping effective-date window.

expire.label: Expire version
expire.description: Mark as expired (typically automatic when expiryDate passes).

archive.label: Archive version
archive.description: Retire this version.

schedulesByTier.description: Rate schedules grouped by tier for this version. Used by rate-lookup UI and aggregation queries.

RateSchedule.title: Rate Schedule
RateSchedule.description: Tier-specific rate entry for a RateCardVersion. Defines a fixed or volume-bracketed rate for a single tier (user / role / project / client / blended) within an effective-date window. Non-overlapping effective windows per (tier, entityId) are enforced (REQ-RATE-006). REQ-RATE-004.

tier.description: Rate tier. Precedence: user > role > project > client > blended (REQ-RATE-005, D6).

entityId.description: Entity identifier for user/role/project/client tiers. NULL for blended-default tier (REQ-RATE-004).

rate.description: Fixed rate per unit in the template currency.

effectiveDate.description: Start date this schedule is active (inclusive). MUST be >= today at creation time (REQ-RATE-009).

expiryDate.description: End date (inclusive); null = open-ended. (tier, entityId) pairs MUST NOT have overlapping effective-date windows (REQ-RATE-006).

volumeBrackets.description: Optional volume-discount brackets. Applied in ascending minUnits order; the matching bracket rate overrides the base rate.

minUnits.description: Minimum units (hours/days) for this bracket to apply.

rate.description: Rate per unit at this volume bracket.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration (per-OU isolation).

active.label: Active
active.description: Schedule is in use for rate lookups within its effective-date window.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Schedule is suspended; excluded from rate lookups.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retired; historical only.

deactivate.label: Deactivate
deactivate.description: Suspend this schedule from rate lookups.

reactivate.label: Reactivate
reactivate.description: Restore this schedule for rate lookups.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Retire this schedule permanently.

resolveRate.description: Rate-lookup aggregation (REQ-RATE-005): given (userId, roleId, projectId, clientId, lookupDate), resolves the most-specific applicable rate by tier precedence (user > role > project > client > blended). Filters by effectiveDate <= lookupDate <= expiryDate, status = active. Returns first match ranked by tier precedence. Per ADR-031: declarative aggregation preferred; falls back to OCA\Shillinq\Guard\RateResolutionGuard if OR aggregation engine does not support parameterised tier-rank sorting.

activeSchedulesByTier.description: Count of active schedules per tier for a given administrationId. Used by Rate Cards index page.

isCurrentlyEffective.description: True when today falls within [effectiveDate, expiryDate] and status=active.
isCurrentlyEffective.expression: status == 'active' AND effectiveDate <= @today AND (expiryDate IS NULL OR expiryDate >= @today)

effectiveWindowLabel.description: Human-readable effective-date window string for UI display.

RateRecord.title: Rate Record
RateRecord.description: Immutable materialized audit-trail entry created for each rate lookup. Stores the resolved tier, rate, effective window, and lookup context so historical rates remain queryable and disputable (REQ-RATE-007, REQ-RATE-010, D4). No updates after creation.

userId.description: Input userId from the rate-lookup request.

roleId.description: Input roleId from the rate-lookup request.

projectId.description: Input projectId from the rate-lookup request.

clientId.description: Input clientId from the rate-lookup request.

resolvedTier.description: Winning tier from rate-lookup precedence (user > role > project > client > blended).

resolvedScheduleId.description: FK to the winning RateSchedule at lookup time (immutable snapshot reference).

resolvedRate.description: Final resolved rate amount at lookup time. Immutable.

resolvedUnit.description: Billing unit of the resolved rate.

effectiveWindowStart.description: effectiveDate of the winning RateSchedule at lookup time.

effectiveWindowEnd.description: expiryDate of the winning RateSchedule at lookup time; null if open-ended.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration (per-OU isolation).

historicalRatesByUser.description: Historical rate audit aggregation (REQ-RATE-010): rate records grouped by resolvedTier and resolvedRate for a given userId and date range. Used by Rate Audit Trail page.

countByTier.description: Count of rate lookups per resolved tier for an administration. Used by Rate Audit Trail widget.

UrenRegistratie.title: Urenregistratie
UrenRegistratie.description: Billable hour logging for ZZP / consultancy. Base schema from bookkeeping-zzp-tax-regime; extended here with recognisedRate (rate-at-write snapshot per RJ 270 §3.2.4) and projectAssignmentId (FK to ProjectAssignment, REQ-CPA-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this hour entry.

personId.description: FK to the person logging the hours.

date.description: Date on which the work was performed (performance date, NOT invoice date).

projectId.description: Optional FK to the Project this hour is billed against.

costProjectId.description: Optional FK to CostProject.id for analytical project-cost tracking per REQ-CPA-101. Independent of projectId (which targets the RJ 270 revenue-recognition Project register).

taskId.description: Optional task identifier for finer-grained time tracking within a project per REQ-CPA-101. Operator-defined (no Task register required).

projectAssignmentId.description: FK to the ProjectAssignment governing this hour entry. References the assignment for rate-card lookup and utilisation aggregation (REQ-CPA-009).

recognisedRate.description: Snapshot of the applicable RateCard.hourlyRate at the time this record is written, per RJ 270 §3.2.4 (rate as of performance date, not invoice date). Immutable after creation — subsequent rate-card revisions do NOT retroactively change this field (REQ-CPA-009).

glTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction when this hour is posted to GL.

wbsoTagId.description: FK to WBSOTag. Null-safe for non-subsidized hour entries. Auto-assigned from parent Project.wbsoTagId on creation if project metadata is complete (REQ-WBSO-004).

activityCodeId.description: FK to WBSOActivityCode. Null-safe for non-subsidized hour entries. Auto-assigned from parent Project.activityCodeId on creation if project metadata is complete (REQ-WBSO-004).

tagSource.description: Indicates how WBSO tags were assigned: auto (inherited from project metadata), manual (operator assignment), or untagged (pending assignment) (REQ-WBSO-004).

wbsoTaggedAt.description: Timestamp when WBSO tags were assigned — either automatically from project metadata or manually by operator (REQ-WBSO-004).

wbsoAutoTag.description: On Urenregistratie create/update: if parent Project.wbsoTagId and Project.activityCodeId are both non-null, auto-assign both to the entry and set tagSource=auto. Otherwise set tagSource=untagged and emit a warning to the operator (REQ-WBSO-004).

onMismatch.warn: Missing WBSO metadata on project — manual activity code assignment required before RVO export.

wbsoEligibleHours.description: Sum of hours for entries where the linked WBSOActivityCode.isAllowed is true. Used for export totals (REQ-WBSO-008).

wbsoIneligibleHours.description: Sum of hours for entries where the linked WBSOActivityCode.isAllowed is false. Tracked but excluded from subsidy submission (REQ-WBSO-008).

utilizationPercent.description: Utilization percentage per REQ-CPA-109: billableHoursThisPeriod / availableHoursThisPeriod × 100. Computed per (personId, fiscalPeriod) grouping. billableHoursThisPeriod aggregates UrenRegistratie.hours for this person in the current FiscalPeriod (where projectId or costProjectId is non-null = billable). availableHoursThisPeriod sources from the assignment's capacityHoursPerWeek × workingWeeksInPeriod (default 40 × period weeks). Clamped to [0, 100].

WipBalance.title: WIP-saldo
WipBalance.description: Period-end work-in-progress snapshot per project, generated by an OR ScheduledWorkflow on T2 period close (REQ-CPA-008).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for which this snapshot was taken.

recognisedRevenue.description: Snapshot of Project.recognisedRevenue at period close.

billedRevenue.description: Snapshot of Project.billedRevenue at period close.

wipBalance.description: Snapshot: recognisedRevenue - billedRevenue at period close.

costsIncurredToDate.description: Snapshot of Project.costsIncurredToDate at period close.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was generated.

x-openregister-scheduled-workflow.description: Triggered by T2 PeriodClosed event. Generates one WipBalance record per active Project per period close (REQ-CPA-008).

project-administrator.description: Read-only; WipBalance records are system-generated, never manually created.

FiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
FiscalYear.description: Fiscal year lifecycle record tracking the open -> closing -> closed -> reopened state machine for year-end close per REQ-YEC-001 through REQ-YEC-006. The open -> closing transition emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type).
