The closing -> closed transition emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next year (balance-sheet accounts only) and fires CloudEvents for dimensional rollover. The admin-only closed -> reopened transition emits two reversing JournalEntry records pairing with the original journals for full audit traceability. No YearEndCloseService PHP class; all close logic is schema-declared per ADR-031.

yearNumber.description: Calendar year reference (e.g. 2026). MUST be unique per administrationId per REQ-YEC-002.

startDate.description: First day of the fiscal year. Typically YYYY-01-01 but supports broken fiscal years per REQ-YEC-002.

endDate.description: Last day of the fiscal year per REQ-YEC-002.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the fiscal year per REQ-YEC-002.

closingJournalId.description: FK to the JournalEntry that posted the year-end retained-earnings transfer (set by open -> closing action per REQ-YEC-003).

openingJournalId.description: FK to the JournalEntry that posted the next-year opening balances (set by closing -> closed action per REQ-YEC-004).

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the close completed. Required when state = closed per REQ-YEC-002.

closedBy.description: NC user id of the actor who completed the close. Required when state = closed per REQ-YEC-002.

reopenedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the year was reopened. Required when state = reopened per REQ-YEC-002.

reopenedBy.description: NC user id of the admin who reopened the fiscal year. Required when state = reopened per REQ-YEC-002.

reopenReason.description: Operator-supplied justification for the reopen. Required (non-empty) when initiating the closed -> reopened transition per REQ-YEC-006.
reopenReason.example: Correction of retained-earnings posting following 2026 audit finding

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this fiscal year. Combined with yearNumber forms the composite uniqueness key per D5.

open.label: Open
open.description: Fiscal year is active; GL transactions post normally to this period.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: Year-end close is in progress (semantically the spec's in-progress state per REQ-YEC-005); retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry posted. GL still writable until the closed transition completes. The closing checklist (REQ-YEC-006) is being evaluated.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Fiscal year is closed. Opening-balance JournalEntry posted for the next year. Dimensional rollover CloudEvents fired. GL becomes immutable for this period per REQ-YEC-007 (archive-period locking via immutablePeriod flag).

immutablePeriod.description: Per REQ-YEC-007: once a FiscalYear enters the closed state, all GLTransaction and GLLine records whose periodId / postingDate resolves to this fiscal year become read-only. New transactions are rejected with NC error 'Fiscal Year @self.yearNumber is closed and immutable. To post corrections, unclose the period (reopen), post the entry, and re-close.' Reads remain unrestricted for audit and reporting.

reopened.label: Reopened
reopened.description: Admin-initiated escape hatch. Two reversing JournalEntry records pair with the original closing and opening journals. GL is writable again.

beginClose.label: Begin year-end close
beginClose.description: Starts the year-end close. Requires all T3 fiscal periods within this year to be in state closed per REQ-YEC-007. Emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type): credits revenue account closing balances to the closing account (isClosingAccount: true per REQ-CoA-009), debits expense account closing balances, posts net result to the retained-earnings equity account per REQ-YEC-003.

close.label: Complete year-end close
close.description: Completes the year-end close. Emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next FiscalYear (balance-sheet accounts only; P&L accounts excluded per REQ-YEC-004). Auto-creates next FiscalYear record in state open if absent. Fires CloudEvents per dimension register (CostCenter, KostenDrager, Project) for dimensional rollover; each subscriber carries active dimensions forward and skips archived per REQ-YEC-005. The transition is gated by the closing checklist (REQ-YEC-006) declared in `requirePreconditions`; CFO override via `overrideChecklist: true` is audit-trailed.

requirePreconditions.label: Trial Balance Verified
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 1: sum(debit GL lines) = sum(credit GL lines) for the FY within rounding tolerance.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Trial Balance Verified: FAIL — imbalance @value cents. Post the correcting entry and try again.

requirePreconditions.label: Accruals Recorded
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 2: when accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) carry a non-zero balance, at least one ClosingEntry with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} (or a JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing) MUST be posted for this FY.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Accruals Recorded: FAIL — accrual accounts carry a non-zero balance but no accrual-reversal closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: Depreciation Posted
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 3: when active FixedAsset records exist for this administration, a ClosingEntry of entryType depreciation MUST be posted for the FY. From T4-base bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Depreciation Posted: FAIL — active fixed assets exist but no depreciation closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: FX Gains/Losses Declared
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 4: when the administration's currency configuration includes a non-base currency, each foreign-currency GL account MUST have an FX revaluation closing entry. Multi-currency revaluation is the T5 boundary; T4 enforces declaration only.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: FX Gains/Losses Declared: FAIL — foreign-currency accounts exist but no FX revaluation closing entry has been declared.

requirePreconditions.label: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed
requirePreconditions.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 5: when any GLTransaction or JournalEntry carries `relatedParty: true`, the financial officer MUST acknowledge them via `GLTransaction.relatedPartyAcknowledged: true` (or the equivalent on JournalEntry).
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed: FAIL — @value related-party transactions remain unacknowledged.

reopen.label: Reopen fiscal year
reopen.description: Admin-only escape hatch per REQ-YEC-006. Emits two JournalEntry records of sub-type reversing pairing with closingJournalId and openingJournalId respectively. Recorded as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream. Non-empty reopenReason required.

onBeginClose.description: Emit retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry on open -> closing per REQ-YEC-003. OR engine sums revenue account closing balances (credit to closing account) and expense account closing balances (debit from closing account); net result posted to retained-earnings equity account.

data.description: Year-end retained-earnings transfer — boekjaar @self.yearNumber. Omzet- en kostenrekeningen afgesloten naar sluitrekening; nettoresultaat geboekt op eigen-vermogenrekening.

onClose.description: Emit opening-balance JournalEntry for the next fiscal year on closing -> closed per REQ-YEC-004. Balance-sheet accounts only (assets, liabilities, equity); P&L accounts excluded. Auto-create next FiscalYear in state open if absent.

data.description: Openingsbalans boekjaar @self.yearNumber + 1. Balansrekeningen overgenomen uit afsluiting boekjaar @self.yearNumber; resultaatrekeningen op nul.

onCloseDimensionRollover.description: Fire CloudEvents for dimensional rollover on closing -> closed per REQ-YEC-005. CostCenter, KostenDrager, and Project subscribers carry active dimensions forward; archived dimensions skipped.

onReopenReverseClosing.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the retained-earnings transfer journal (closingJournalId) on closed -> reopened per REQ-YEC-006.

onReopenReverseOpening.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the opening-balance journal (openingJournalId) on closed -> reopened per REQ-YEC-006.

onReopenNotify.description: Record the reopen as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream per REQ-YEC-006.

onBeginCloseGenerateClosingEntries.description: Per REQ-YEC-010: when the FiscalYear enters the closing state, auto-generate ClosingEntry records from every active ClosingEntryTemplate whose automationTrigger is on-close. For each matching template, sum the GL line balances inside the accountPattern range for this FY, create a ClosingEntry of the corresponding entryType (revenue-closing, expense-closing, accrual-reversal, …) with approvalStatus: pending-approval and automationTemplate: @template.templateId. When the template's reverseNextPeriod is true, generate a companion accrual-reversal ClosingEntry on the next FY (created as draft until the next FY activates). Per REQ-YEC-004 / REQ-YEC-010.

data.description: Reversal of @template.templateName from FY @self.yearNumber, generated alongside the closing entry per REQ-YEC-010.

onCloseMaterialiseRetainedEarnings.description: Per REQ-YEC-002 / REQ-YEC-009: on closing -> closed, materialise the RetainedEarnings record for this FY. Sums net income (revenue closing - expense closing) and rolls openingBalanceCents forward from the prior FY's closingBalanceCents. Links to the retained-earnings ClosingEntry that posts the equity-side transfer.

trialBalanceImbalanceCents.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 1 backing aggregation: absolute difference (in cents) between debit and credit GL line totals for this FY's GLTransactions in posted state. Feeds the trial-balance-verified checklist precondition. Tolerance is enforced via the precondition's thresholdCents.
trialBalanceImbalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit'))

accrualReversalCoverage.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 2 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} or JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing for this FY. Feeds the accruals-recorded checklist precondition.

accrualAccountBalanceCents.description: Helper aggregation: sum of cents balance on accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) for this FY. Used by the accruals-recorded precondition's appliesWhen gate.
accrualAccountBalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit'))

depreciationClosingEntryCount.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 3 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType = depreciation for this FY. Feeds the depreciation-posted checklist precondition.

activeFixedAssetCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of FixedAsset records in lifecycleState = active for this administration. Used by the depreciation-posted precondition's appliesWhen gate.

foreignCurrencyFxCoverage.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 4 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with currency != base currency for this FY (FX revaluation entries). Feeds the fx-declared checklist precondition.

foreignCurrencyAccountCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of GLTransaction records on this FY where currency differs from the administration's base currency (EUR by default). Used by the fx-declared precondition's appliesWhen gate.

relatedPartyUnacknowledgedCount.description: REQ-YEC-006 item 5 backing aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true but relatedPartyAcknowledged != true for this FY. Feeds the related-party-reviewed checklist precondition.

relatedPartyTransactionCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true for this FY. Used by the related-party-reviewed precondition's appliesWhen gate.

netIncomeCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of credit-side revenue (account range 4000-4999) minus debit-side expense (account range 5000-6999) for this FY in posted GL lines.
netIncomeCents.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN amountCents ELSE -amountCents END) WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 5000 AND 6999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN -amountCents ELSE amountCents END) ELSE 0 END)

priorRetainedEarningsClosingCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: prior FY's RetainedEarnings.closingBalanceCents (0 for the very first FY).

distributionsCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of distributions posted to the distribution-accounts range (default 9750-9799) for this FY. Operators override this range via the chart-of-accounts configuration.

balanceCarryforwardValid.description: REQ-YEC-008 cross-FY balance-carryforward validation. Aggregation precondition on the next FY's open -> ... activation: confirms the next FY's opening-balance GL postings match the prior FY's closing balances per balance-sheet account. Returns 0 if perfectly matched (within rounding tolerance); positive integer counts mismatched accounts.
balanceCarryforwardValid.failMessage: Balance carryforward: @value account(s) show a closing/opening mismatch greater than 1 cent. Re-run the opening-balance JournalEntry from the prior FY's close.

onReopen.description: Notify all administration admins when a fiscal year is reopened. A reopened closed year is a high-stakes audit event.
onReopen.title: Boekjaar heropend

ClosingEntry.title: Closing Entry
ClosingEntry.description: A manual or automated year-end closing entry per REQ-YEC-001. Tracks accrual postings, reversals, revenue/expense closings to the income-summary account, depreciation postings, retained-earnings rollforward, and opening-balance seeding. Materialises as a balanced GLTransaction via the JournalEntry materialisation pattern (T1) when approved and posted. All amounts are stored as integer-cent for money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based money convention.

closingEntryNumber.description: Sequential closing-entry number unique per administration (e.g. CE-2026-0001). Per REQ-YEC-001.

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this closing entry belongs to. Per REQ-YEC-001.

entryDate.description: Posting date of the closing entry. Typically the last day of the fiscal year (or first day of next FY for opening-balance entries). Per REQ-YEC-001.

entryType.description: Classification of the closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.

description.description: Operator-authored description of the entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.
description.example: Close revenue accounts 4000-4999 to income summary 9900

automationTemplate.description: FK to ClosingEntryTemplate.templateId when this entry was generated automatically by a template. Per REQ-YEC-001 / REQ-YEC-010.

amountCents.description: Total closing-entry amount in minor units of the currency (integer cents). Per REQ-YEC-001. Money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based convention.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the closing entry amount.

glTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction that materialised this closing entry when posted. Set by the lifecycle action on transition:post per REQ-YEC-009.

approvalStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the closing entry. draft -> pending-approval -> approved -> posted; or posted -> reversed. Per REQ-YEC-001 / REQ-YEC-009.

approvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the financial officer / CFO who approved this closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the closing entry was approved. Per REQ-YEC-001.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this closing entry. Per REQ-YEC-001.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Editable. Not yet visible to approvers.

pending-approval.label: Pending approval
pending-approval.description: Submitted for CFO / financial-officer approval. Editable only by the originating bookkeeper until approved or rejected.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by CFO / financial officer. Ready to post to the GL.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Materialised as a balanced GLTransaction. Immutable from the closing-entry side; reversed only via a compensating closing entry.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Superseded by a compensating closing entry. Excluded from active reporting but remains queryable for audit.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Bookkeeper submits the closing entry to the CFO for review per REQ-YEC-001.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: CFO / financial-officer approves the closing entry per REQ-YEC-001.

post.label: Post to GL
post.description: Materialise the closing entry as a balanced GLTransaction with matching GLLine rows per REQ-YEC-009. The lifecycle action invokes the same materialisation extension T1 uses for JournalEntry per ADR-031.

reverse.label: Reverse
reverse.description: Mark this closing entry as reversed. A compensating closing entry must be created and posted separately to keep the GL balanced.

onPost.description: Materialise the approved closing entry as a balanced GLTransaction with matching GLLine rows per REQ-YEC-009. The lifecycle action mirrors the JournalEntry materialisation extension (T1). Lines are derived from the linked ClosingEntryTemplate.accountPattern (for automated entries) or from the operator-supplied draft body (for manual entries).

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year this closing entry belongs to.

template.description: The closing-entry template that generated this entry (when generated automatically).

glTransaction.description: The materialised GL transaction (set when the entry is posted).

RetainedEarnings.title: Retained Earnings
RetainedEarnings.description: Tracks the retained-earnings sub-ledger position per fiscal year per REQ-YEC-002: opening balance, net income for the period, distributions paid, and closing balance. Materialised via the FiscalYear close lifecycle (retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry) and linked to its driving ClosingEntry. Sub-ledger view onto the equity-side retained-earnings GL account. All amounts in integer cents (money-safe).

retainedEarningsId.description: Operator-stable identifier for this retained-earnings record. Per REQ-YEC-002.

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this record covers. One RetainedEarnings record per (fiscalYearId, administrationId). Per REQ-YEC-002.

openingBalanceCents.description: Retained earnings at the start of the fiscal year in integer cents (signed; negative values represent accumulated deficit). Equals prior FY closingBalanceCents per REQ-YEC-002 rollforward.

netIncomeCents.description: Net income for the fiscal year (revenue minus expenses) in integer cents (signed; negative = net loss). Calculated as the income-summary closing balance after revenue and expense closing entries are posted. Per REQ-YEC-002.

distributionsCents.description: Dividends or distributions paid out during the fiscal year in integer cents (non-negative). Deducted from net income for closing-balance calculation. Per REQ-YEC-002.

closingBalanceCents.description: Retained earnings at the end of the fiscal year in integer cents (signed). Computed as openingBalanceCents + netIncomeCents - distributionsCents per REQ-YEC-002.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the retained-earnings balances.

closingEntryId.description: FK to the ClosingEntry that materialised the retained-earnings transfer for this FY. Set when the FY close lifecycle posts the entry per REQ-YEC-002 / REQ-YEC-009.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this retained-earnings record. Composite uniqueness with fiscalYearId per D5.

fiscalYear.description: The fiscal year this retained-earnings record covers.

closingEntry.description: The closing entry that materialised the retained-earnings rollforward.

validateRollforward.description: Validate the retained-earnings rollforward identity per REQ-YEC-002: closingBalanceCents == openingBalanceCents + netIncomeCents - (distributionsCents OR 0). Evaluated by the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition before the period locks.

validateCarryforward.description: Validate that this FY's openingBalanceCents equals the prior FY's closingBalanceCents (within rounding tolerance) per REQ-YEC-008.

ClosingAccount.title: Closing Account
ClosingAccount.description: Designates the single closing / income-summary account per administration (typically account 9900) per REQ-YEC-003. All revenue and expense closing entries flow through this account before being transferred to retained earnings. Supports time-bounded historicity via `effectiveFrom` so administrations can rotate their closing account across fiscal years if needed.

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. Typically 9900 (income summary) or another equity-side closing account. Per REQ-YEC-003.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration. One active ClosingAccount per administration at any point in time per REQ-YEC-003.

isActive.description: Whether this is the currently active closing account for the administration. The lifecycle action on ClosingEntry / FiscalYear close selects the active record. Per REQ-YEC-003.

effectiveFrom.description: Optional start date if the administration rotates closing accounts across fiscal years (e.g. switching from 9900 to 9990). When null, this ClosingAccount applies indefinitely. Per REQ-YEC-003.

account.description: The GL account designated as the closing / income-summary account.

ClosingEntryTemplate.title: Closing Entry Template
ClosingEntryTemplate.description: Declarative rule that drives automated closing-entry generation per REQ-YEC-004. Each template matches a range of account numbers, transfers their balances to the configured closing account, and optionally reverses in the next period. Lifecycle (active/paused/archived) lets operators disable templates without deleting them. Templates are consumed by the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition per REQ-YEC-010 and by the ClosingEntry materialisation hook per REQ-YEC-009.

templateId.description: Stable operator-readable identifier (e.g. revenue-closing). Unique per administrationId. Per REQ-YEC-004.

templateName.description: Display name shown in the closing-entry generation UI. Per REQ-YEC-004.

description.description: Operator documentation of what this template does. Per REQ-YEC-004.
description.example: Close all revenue accounts (4000-4999) to income summary (9900).

accountPattern.description: Account range or regex matching the GL accounts whose balances close through this template (e.g. 4000-4999 for revenue accounts, 5000-6999 for expense accounts). Per REQ-YEC-004.

closingAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. The target closing / income-summary account (typically 9900). Per REQ-YEC-004.

reverseNextPeriod.description: When true, an accrual-reversal closing entry is generated in the next fiscal year reversing this one. Used for prior-period accrual reversals per REQ-YEC-004.

automationTrigger.description: When this template fires. on-close = at the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition (default); on-check = during the closing checklist; manual = only when explicitly invoked. Per REQ-YEC-004.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this template. Per REQ-YEC-004.

lifecycleState.description: Whether this template is consumed by the FiscalYear close lifecycle. paused = skipped this cycle but remains in the catalogue; archived = retained for audit only. Per REQ-YEC-004.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this template was created. Per REQ-YEC-004.

modifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this template was last modified. Per REQ-YEC-004.

active.label: Active
active.description: Consumed by the FiscalYear close lifecycle when automationTrigger matches.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Skipped by the close lifecycle but remains in the catalogue and may be re-activated.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit purposes only. Never executed.

pause.label: Pause template
pause.description: Stop this template from firing during the next close cycle.

archive.label: Archive template
archive.description: Permanently retire this template (kept for audit).

closingAccount.description: The GL account these closing entries flow through.

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.description: Scanned or uploaded receipt photo with amount, date, expense category, and multi-currency support. Linked to a parent ExpenseClaimEntry for approval and reimbursement. Per REQ-EC-002.

receiptNumber.description: Shillinq-side sequential receipt ID per administration (e.g. REC-2026-0001).

photoUri.description: URI to the uploaded receipt photo (S3, local FS, or docudesk). Required before claim submission per REQ-EC-002.

extractedText.description: OCR placeholder — populated in T3. Null in T2.

amount.description: Receipt total in the original currency. Must be non-negative per REQ-EC-002.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the original receipt amount.

amountInBaseCurrency.description: Amount converted to base currency (EUR) at capture time per REQ-EC-009. Auto-set by multi-currency capability lookup.

exchangeRate.description: Conversion rate used (original / base); null when receipt was already in base currency. Retained for audit immutability per REQ-EC-009.

category.description: Expense category (e.g. travel, meals, supplies, accommodation).

claimId.description: FK to parent ExpenseClaimEntry.id; null until the receipt is added to a claim.

costCentreCode.description: Cost centre allocation for this receipt line (may differ per claim line).

vendorName.description: Vendor or business where the expense was incurred.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this receipt.

photoValidation.description: File-type and size guard for receipt photo uploads per REQ-EC-008. Accepted types: image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf. Maximum size: 10 MB. Declarative file-type check not supported by the OR engine — ADR-031 exception guard OCA\Shillinq\Validation\PhotoValidator::validate() is invoked instead.

multiCurrencyConversion.description: When currency != base (EUR), looks up the exchange rate for receiptDate from the multi-currency capability snapshot and populates amountInBaseCurrency and exchangeRate per REQ-EC-009. Prompts operator to enter manual rate if snapshot is unavailable.

claim.description: Parent expense claim this receipt belongs to.

employee.description: Employees may upload and edit their own receipts.

bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers have full access for corrections and audit.

MileageEntry.title: Mileage Entry
MileageEntry.description: Journey log capturing distance travelled, vehicle type, and applicable rate per kilometre. totalAmount is auto-calculated as distance × ratePerKm per REQ-EC-003. Linked to a parent ExpenseClaimEntry for approval and reimbursement.

mileageNumber.description: Shillinq-side sequential mileage ID per administration (e.g. MLG-2026-0001).

distance.description: Distance in kilometres (manual entry in T2; optional geocoding in T3). Must be positive per REQ-EC-003.

vehicleType.description: Vehicle type used for the journey; drives rate lookup from MileageRate master table.

ratePerKm.description: Applied rate in EUR per kilometre, looked up from MileageRate master table for (fiscalYear, vehicleType, country). Locked at claim submission for audit immutability.

totalAmount.description: Auto-calculated reimbursement: distance × ratePerKm per REQ-EC-003. Do not set directly.

purpose.description: Reason for travel (business meeting, client visit, training, etc.).

claimId.description: FK to parent ExpenseClaimEntry.id; null until added to a claim.

costCentreCode.description: Cost centre for GL line allocation.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mileage entry.

totalAmount.description: Auto-calculated: distance × ratePerKm per REQ-EC-003. Recalculated on every save while the parent claim is in draft state.

ratePerKmLookup.description: Looks up the current rate per km from MileageRate master table by (fiscalYear derived from journeyDate, vehicleType, country derived from administrationId). Populates ratePerKm field. Locked at claim submission.

claim.description: Parent expense claim this mileage entry belongs to.

employee.description: Employees may create and edit their own mileage entries.

bookkeeper.description: Full access for corrections and audit.

PerDiem.title: Per Diem
PerDiem.description: Daily travel allowance claimed per country and night count. allowanceAmount is auto-calculated as nightCount × dailyRate per REQ-EC-004. Country-specific rates are maintained in the PerDiemRate master table per fiscal year.

perDiemNumber.description: Shillinq-side sequential per-diem ID per administration (e.g. PDM-2026-0001).

travelStartDate.description: First day of the travel period.

travelEndDate.description: Last day of the travel period.

nightCount.description: Number of nights away from home base. System issues a warning (not error) when nightCount does not match travelStartDate/travelEndDate span per REQ-EC-004.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where travel occurred. Must be a valid code per REQ-EC-004.

dailyRate.description: Official daily allowance rate in EUR per day, looked up from PerDiemRate master table by (country, calendarYear). Locked at claim submission for audit immutability.

allowanceAmount.description: Auto-calculated: nightCount × dailyRate per REQ-EC-004. Do not set directly.

claimId.description: FK to parent ExpenseClaimEntry.id; null until added to a claim.

costCentreCode.description: Cost centre for GL line allocation.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this per-diem record.

allowanceAmount.description: Auto-calculated: nightCount × dailyRate per REQ-EC-004. Recalculated on every save while parent claim is in draft state.

dailyRateLookup.description: Looks up the current daily rate from PerDiemRate master table by (calendarYear derived from travelStartDate, country). Populates dailyRate field. Locked at claim submission.

nightCountWarning.description: Issues a non-blocking warning when nightCount does not match the calendar span (travelEndDate - travelStartDate) per REQ-EC-004. Returns null when counts match, a warning message string otherwise.
nightCountWarning.expression: datediff(@self.travelEndDate, @self.travelStartDate) != @self.nightCount ? 'Night count does not match travel dates — please verify' : null

claim.description: Parent expense claim this per-diem record belongs to.

employee.description: Employees may create and edit their own per-diem entries.

bookkeeper.description: Full access for corrections and audit.

ExpenseClaimEntry.title: Expense Claim
ExpenseClaimEntry.description: Operator-curated batch grouping N receipts, mileage journeys, and per-diem records into a single claim for approval and reimbursement. Lifecycle: draft → submitted → approved → posted → reimbursed with disputed/voided branches. Approval routing consumes OR approval-workflow per ADR-022 (no app-local approval table). Posting materialises a balanced GL entry per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern. Per REQ-EC-005 through REQ-EC-013.

claimNumber.description: Shillinq-side sequential claim ID per administration (e.g. EXP-2026-0001).

employeeId.description: FK to Person (employee submitting the claim).

submittedDate.description: Timestamp when the claim was formally submitted for approval. Set by the submit lifecycle transition.

fromDate.description: Start date of the expense period covered by this claim.

toDate.description: End date of the expense period covered by this claim.

totalAmount.description: Sum of Receipt.amountInBaseCurrency + MileageEntry.totalAmount + PerDiem.allowanceAmount across all linked items. Auto-aggregated; always EUR (base currency) per REQ-EC-005.

currency.description: Always EUR (base currency) in T2. T5 adds multi-currency claims.

approvalState.description: State of the OR approval-workflow for this claim per REQ-EC-006. Managed by OR approval-workflow engine; do not set directly.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the expense claim per REQ-EC-007.

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction UUID once the claim is posted. Set by the post lifecycle action per REQ-EC-012.

costCentreAllocations.description: Claim-wide cost centre allocation map ({costCentreCode: percentage}). Per-line codes on Receipt/MileageEntry/PerDiem take precedence.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this claim.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Line items may be added, edited, or removed.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted for approval. Awaiting OR approval-workflow decision per REQ-EC-006.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by authorised approver(s). Ready for GL posting.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. GL entry materialised; awaiting reimbursement payment match per REQ-EC-012.

reimbursed.label: Reimbursed
reimbursed.description: Reimbursement payment matched or recorded. Claim closed.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Payment held under investigation. GL entry remains valid.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Claim voided. Corresponding GLTransaction must already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Operator submits the draft claim. Guard: all line items (receipts, mileage, per-diem) must have costCentreCode set per REQ-EC-007. Claim must have at least one line item.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Approved by authorised approver(s) via OR approval-workflow per REQ-EC-006. Sets approvalState: approved.

reject.label: Reject (return to draft)
reject.description: Approver rejects the claim; sets approvalState: rejected and returns claim to draft for operator revision.

post.label: Post
post.description: Post the claim. Guards: (1) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004; (2) all line items have costCentreCode set. Action: materialise one balanced GLTransaction per REQ-EC-012 (debit expense lines per cost centre, credit expense-payable account).

actions.description: Emit one balanced GLTransaction: debit per expense line (Receipt→expense account/CC, MileageEntry→mileage-reimbursement account/CC, PerDiem→per-diem account/CC), credit to expense-payable account (Account.isExpenseControlAccount=true). Sets glTransactionId back-reference per REQ-EC-012.

markReimbursed.label: Mark as reimbursed
markReimbursed.description: Transition to reimbursed when a payment record or bank-reconciliation event matches the claim total per REQ-EC-007.

dispute.label: Raise dispute
dispute.description: Operator places payment hold pending investigation. GL entry remains valid.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Operator resolves the dispute; claim returns to posted awaiting payment.

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted claim. Guard: the materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

thresholds.description: Claims at or below €500 are auto-approved (approvalState: not-required) per REQ-EC-010.
Claims above €500 and at or below €5,000 require manager approval per REQ-EC-010.
Claims above €5,000 require CFO approval with dual-control (two independent approvals) per REQ-EC-010.

x-openregister-approval.note: All approval policy configuration (thresholds, roles, delegation) is managed through OR's approval-workflow UI per ADR-022. No app-local approval table.

expenseReportByCategoryAndCostCentre.description: Expense report grouping ExpenseClaimEntry by expense category and cost centre for management reporting and tax audit per REQ-EC-011. Excludes voided and disputed claims.

claimTotalAmount.description: Auto-aggregates totalAmount from all linked Receipt.amountInBaseCurrency + MileageEntry.totalAmount + PerDiem.allowanceAmount. Recalculated on every line-item save per REQ-EC-005.

receipts.description: All Receipt records linked to this claim.

mileageEntries.description: All MileageEntry records linked to this claim.

perDiemEntries.description: All PerDiem records linked to this claim.

employee.description: Employees may create and edit their own claims in draft state.

manager.description: Managers may approve or reject submitted claims.

bookkeeper.description: Full access for corrections and GL posting.

MileageRate.title: Mileage Rate
MileageRate.description: Master data table of reimbursement rates per kilometre by fiscal year, vehicle type, and tax jurisdiction. Seeded with NL and FI 2026 rates per design.md Seed Data. Operators maintain rates per fiscal year; MileageEntry.ratePerKm is looked up from this table at capture time and locked at claim submission per REQ-EC-003 and Task 16.

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this rate applies to (e.g. 2026).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the tax jurisdiction.

vehicleType.description: Vehicle type this rate applies to.

ratePerKm.description: Rate per kilometre in EUR for the given fiscal year, country, and vehicle type.

notes.description: Source or regulatory reference for this rate (e.g. 'IB 2025 rules').

bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers maintain mileage rate master data per fiscal year.

employee.description: Read-only: employees may view the applicable rate.

PerDiemRate.title: Per Diem Rate
PerDiemRate.description: Master data table of official daily travel allowance rates per country and calendar year. Seeded with NL and FI 2026 rates per design.md Seed Data. Operators maintain rates per calendar year; PerDiem.dailyRate is looked up from this table at capture time and locked at claim submission per REQ-EC-004 and Task 16.

calendarYear.description: Calendar year this rate applies to (e.g. 2026).

dailyRate.description: Official daily allowance rate in the stated currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the daily rate (almost always EUR for NL/FI).

source.description: Regulatory source for this rate (e.g. 'Ministry travel rules').

bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers maintain per-diem rate master data per calendar year.

employee.description: Read-only: employees may view applicable rates.

InventoryReorderRule.title: Inventory Reorder Rule
InventoryReorderRule.description: Per-item, per-location reorder policy declaring min/max stock levels, lead-time-aware reorder-point thresholds, low-stock alert policy, and optional auto-purchase-order generation. Reorder decision logic is fully declarative via x-openregister-lifecycle, x-openregister-aggregations, and x-openregister-notifications per ADR-031 and ADR-022. No PHP InventoryReorderService — all reorder triggers and alert dispatch are schema-driven.

inventoryStockId.description: FK to InventoryStock record (item + location combination). The reorder rule applies specifically to this stock entry.

supplierId.description: FK to primary Supplier for reorder. If null, operator selects supplier manually at order time.

minimumLevel.description: Stock quantity at or below which a low-stock alert is triggered. REQ-IRA-003.

maximumLevel.description: Target stock quantity for replenishment. Must be greater than minimumLevel.

reorderPoint.description: Stock quantity at which reorder is triggered, factoring supplier lead time. Formula: (expectedDailyUsage × leadTimeDays) + safetyStock. REQ-IRA-005.

reorderQuantity.description: Standard quantity to order on alert. Used as PO line quantity when auto-PO fires. REQ-IRA-006.

leadTimeDays.description: Supplier lead time in calendar days. Defaults to supplier.leadTimeDays when null; falls back to 7 days if supplier has no lead time. REQ-IRA-005.

safetyStockDays.description: Safety margin in days above lead time for reorder-point calculation. REQ-IRA-005.

alertThreshold.description: Percentage above minimumLevel at which a warning alert fires (early warning before critical low-stock). E.g. 20 means alert at minimumLevel × 1.20.

autoPurchaseOrder.description: Whether to automatically generate a PurchaseOrder when the low-stock alert fires. REQ-IRA-006.

autoPurchaseOrderApprovalRequired.description: Whether auto-generated PO requires operator approval before issue. When true PO lands in draft state; when false PO is issued immediately (within spendingLimit). REQ-IRA-006.

spendingLimit.description: Maximum spend per auto-generated PO in EUR. If reorderQuantity × supplier.currentPrice exceeds this, the auto-order is blocked and escalated to role='procurement-manager'. REQ-IRA-006.

alertChannel.description: Notification channel for low-stock alerts. REQ-IRA-004.

alertRecipients.description: Email addresses or Nextcloud user IDs to notify on low-stock alert. REQ-IRA-004.

snoozeUntil.description: Temporarily suppress low-stock alerts until this datetime. Operator sets this to acknowledge a situation in progress. REQ-IRA-003.

lifecycleState.description: Current reorder rule lifecycle state. Only active rules fire low-stock alerts and trigger auto-PO. REQ-IRA-009.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration that owns this reorder rule. Rules are scoped per administration for multi-tenant isolation.

active.label: Active
active.description: Rule is monitoring stock levels. Low-stock alerts fire when quantity ≤ minimumLevel. Auto-PO triggers if enabled.

paused.label: Paused
paused.description: Alert dispatch disabled. No auto-PO until rule is resumed. Stock monitoring suspended (e.g. during planned stockout or supplier change).

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Rule permanently deactivated. No alerts, no auto-PO. Retained for audit trail.

pause.label: Pause rule
pause.description: Suspend alert monitoring. Use when a stockout is expected or the supplier relationship is on hold. REQ-IRA-009.

resume.label: Resume rule
resume.description: Re-activate alert monitoring after planned suspension. REQ-IRA-009.

archive.label: Archive rule
archive.description: Permanently deactivate the rule. Audit trail is preserved. REQ-IRA-009.

restore.label: Restore rule
restore.description: Re-activate an archived rule (e.g. seasonal product restocking). REQ-IRA-009.

payload.message: Reorder rule has been paused. No alerts will fire until resumed.

lowStockTrigger.description: Evaluates whether the linked InventoryStock quantity has fallen to or below the reorderPoint. Fires on every InventoryStock quantity change. When true, triggers the low-stock alert lifecycle action. REQ-IRA-007.

lowStockDashboard.description: Aggregates InventoryStock records below their minimum level grouped by location. Powers the Stock Levels Dashboard widget. REQ-IRA-008.

lowStockAlert.description: Dispatches a low-stock alert when InventoryStock.quantity ≤ minimumLevel and lifecycleState = active and (snoozeUntil is null or snoozeUntil < now). REQ-IRA-004.

spendingLimitExceeded.description: Dispatches an escalation notification to procurement-manager role when auto-PO total exceeds spendingLimit. REQ-IRA-006.

reorderPointCalculated.description: Computes the lead-time-aware reorder point. Formula: (expectedDailyUsage × leadTimeDays) + safetyStock. Falls back to minimumLevel + (leadTimeDays × 5) + 10 if expectedDailyUsage unavailable. Operator may override reorderPoint manually. REQ-IRA-005.
reorderPointCalculated.expression: IF({expectedDailyUsage} IS NOT NULL, ({expectedDailyUsage} * COALESCE({leadTimeDays}, 7)) + ({expectedDailyUsage} * COALESCE({safetyStockDays}, 1)), {minimumLevel} + (COALESCE({leadTimeDays}, 7) * 5) + 10)

isLowStock.description: True when the linked InventoryStock quantity is at or below minimumLevel and rule is active. Used for dashboard filtering without a separate aggregation round-trip.

warehouse-manager.description: Warehouse managers maintain reorder rules per location.

procurement.description: Procurement team monitors and adjusts reorder rules.

inventory-viewer.description: Read-only access to reorder rules for auditing.

CashflowForecastHorizon.title: Cashflow Forecast Horizon
CashflowForecastHorizon.description: Rolling 13-week cashflow forecast window for one administration. Window shifts forward every Monday 02:00 UTC: week-1 is archived, week-13 is appended. Aggregates AR/AP/recurring/tax projections via x-openregister-aggregations; no PHP forecast engine. Per ADR-031 and ADR-022. REQ-CF-000, REQ-CF-001.

horizonId.description: Unique identifier for this forecast horizon.

ondernemingId.description: FK to the Corporation/Onderneming owning this horizon. REQ-CF-001.

horizonEind.description: Last day (Sunday) of the 13-week window (horizonStart + 90 days).

rolledOp.description: Timestamp of the most recent weekly roll (Monday 02:00 UTC). REQ-CF-000.

openingSaldo.description: Opening balance breakdown across the four spaardoel buckets. REQ-CF-001, REQ-CF-014.

zakelijkeRekening.description: Saldo on the operational business account.

modelVersie.description: Version of the forecast model in effect. REQ-CF-017.

kalibratieScore.description: Forecast accuracy score (0-1) derived from prior-month MAPE calibration. REQ-CF-013.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration tenant. Multi-tenant isolation.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state per REQ-CF-000.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Horizon initialized but not yet activated.

active.label: Active
active.description: Horizon receives weekly Monday-02:00-UTC rolls and daily bankfeed reconciliation.

rolling.label: Rolling
rolling.description: Transient state during the Monday roll: week-1 is being archived, week-13 appended.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Horizon no longer rolling. Historical snapshot retained for audit and calibration trail.

activate.label: Activate forecast
activate.description: Begin weekly Monday roll + daily bankfeed reconciliation.

beginRoll.label: Begin weekly roll
beginRoll.description: Triggered by HorizonRollingJob at Monday 02:00 UTC.

completeRoll.label: Complete weekly roll
completeRoll.description: Week-1 archived, week-13 appended, rolledOp updated.

archive.label: Archive horizon
archive.description: Stop all rolls. Retain for audit.

bufferPolicyEvaluation.description: Evaluates each CashflowWeek under this horizon against its CashflowBufferPolicy. Powers REQ-CF-009 alert escalation.

select.bufferStatus: CASE WHEN CashflowWeek.eindSaldo < CashflowBufferPolicy.alertOndergrens THEN 'CRISIS' WHEN CashflowWeek.eindSaldo < CashflowBufferPolicy.alertVooralarm THEN 'VOORALARM' ELSE 'BOVEN_BUFFER' END

crisisDetection.description: Detects weeks 1-4 with predicted negative saldo. Triggers crisis-mode activation. REQ-CF-010.
crisisDetection.filter: CashflowWeek.horizonId = {horizonId} AND CashflowWeek.eindSaldo < 0 AND CashflowWeek.weeknummer <= ({horizonStart} + 28 days)

CashflowWeek.title: Cashflow Week
CashflowWeek.description: One weekly slot within a 13-week CashflowForecastHorizon. Aggregates projected inflows (AR, pipeline, overig) and outflows (AP, recurring, BTW, IB, investeringen) and computes net mutatie + eindSaldo. Buffer status and alerts are populated via x-openregister-aggregations. REQ-CF-002.

weekId.description: Unique identifier for this weekly slot.

openingSaldo.description: Opening balance for the week (= prior week's eindSaldo, or horizon openingSaldo.totaal for week-1).

inflows_ar_gerealiseerd.description: Actual AR receipts from bankfeed (filled post-reconciliation). REQ-CF-012.

inflows_pipeline.description: Probabilistic revenue from pipelinq deals (deal.amount x deal.probability).

inflows_overig.description: Interest income, refunds, other miscellaneous inflows.

outflows_btw_afdracht.description: Quarterly BTW settlement (if due this week, per Belastingdienst calendar). REQ-CF-007.

outflows_ib_aanslag.description: Annual IB/VPB settlement (if due this week, per peilmaanden). REQ-CF-008.

outflows_investeringen.description: Capital expenditure scheduled for this week.

bufferStatus.description: Buffer-policy status derived from eindSaldo vs CashflowBufferPolicy thresholds. REQ-CF-009.

alerts.description: Alert records populated by buffer-policy evaluation. REQ-CF-009, REQ-CF-010.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration tenant.

arInflowProjection.description: Aggregates CashflowARProjection records into inflows_ar_geprognosticeerd by week. REQ-CF-002, REQ-CF-003.

apOutflowSchedule.description: Aggregates CashflowAPSchedule records into outflows_ap_geprognosticeerd by week. REQ-CF-006.

recurringExpansion.description: Expands CashflowRecurring entries (huur, verzekering, abonnementen, dga_loon, lijfrentepremie) into per-category outflow columns by week. Applies geldigVan/geldigTot lifecycle filtering and CPI indexing on annual items. REQ-CF-005.
recurringExpansion.filter: (CashflowRecurring.geldigVan <= CashflowWeek.weekEind) AND (CashflowRecurring.geldigTot IS NULL OR CashflowRecurring.geldigTot >= CashflowWeek.weekStart)

matchFrequency.JAARLIJKS: MONTH(CashflowWeek.weekStart) = CashflowRecurring.maandVanJaar AND DAY(CashflowWeek.weekStart) <= CashflowRecurring.dagVanMaand AND CashflowRecurring.dagVanMaand <= DAY(CashflowWeek.weekEind)

taxAfdrachtProjection.description: Hardcoded Belastingdienst calendar: Q1 due Apr 30, Q2 due Jul 31, Q3 due Oct 31, Q4 due Jan 31. Projects amounts based on trailing-quarter turnover x VAT rate (21% standard). REQ-CF-007, REQ-CF-008.

BTW_Q1.basis: SUM(ARInvoice.totalAmount WHERE MONTH(invoiceDate) IN (1,2,3) AND YEAR(invoiceDate) = {year}) * 0.21

BTW_Q2.basis: SUM(ARInvoice.totalAmount WHERE MONTH(invoiceDate) IN (4,5,6) AND YEAR(invoiceDate) = {year}) * 0.21

BTW_Q3.basis: SUM(ARInvoice.totalAmount WHERE MONTH(invoiceDate) IN (7,8,9) AND YEAR(invoiceDate) = {year}) * 0.21

BTW_Q4.basis: SUM(ARInvoice.totalAmount WHERE MONTH(invoiceDate) IN (10,11,12) AND YEAR(invoiceDate) = {year}) * 0.21

bufferStatusEvaluation.description: Evaluates eindSaldo against CashflowBufferPolicy thresholds and sets bufferStatus enum + alert records. REQ-CF-009, REQ-CF-010.

CashflowARProjection.title: Cashflow AR Projection
CashflowARProjection.description: Projected expected-receipt date per open AR invoice, derived from customer-specific betalingsgedrag (12-month moving average + confidence). REQ-CF-003, REQ-CF-004.

arInvoiceId.description: FK to the AR invoice. Read-only.

klantId.description: De-normalized customer identifier for reporting + grouping.

verwachtOntvangstDatum.description: Projected receipt date: vervalDatum + betalingsgedrag mean offset. REQ-CF-003.

betalingsHistorie_gemiddeldeAfwijking.description: Mean payment offset from due date (e.g., '+13 days').

betalingsHistorie_facturen12mnd.description: Number of settled invoices in 12-month sample for this customer.

betalingsHistorie_betaaldVoorVerval.description: Number of those that were paid on-or-before due date.

betrouwbaarheidScore.description: Confidence in projection (0-1). Equals min(1.0, facturen12mnd / 12). REQ-CF-003.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

CashflowAPSchedule.title: Cashflow AP Schedule
CashflowAPSchedule.description: Scheduled outflow per open AP invoice within the 13-week horizon. Read-only projection grouped per CashflowWeek. REQ-CF-006.

apTransactionId.description: FK to the AP invoice/transaction. Read-only.

geplandeBetaalDatum.description: Scheduled payment date (typically equals vervalDatum unless deferred).

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

CashflowRecurring.title: Cashflow Recurring
CashflowRecurring.description: Declarative recurring-cost entry (huur, verzekering, abonnementen, DGA-loon, lijfrentepremie, leasing). Lifecycle: active/suspended/ended via geldigVan/geldigTot. Indexing: FIXED or CPI_AFGELOPEN_JAAR. REQ-CF-005.

categorie.description: Recurring category. Determines which outflows_recurring_* column in CashflowWeek receives the amount.

richting.description: Direction: IN (inflow, e.g. recurring contract revenue) or OUT (outflow).

dagVanMaand.description: Day of month for monthly recurrence; null for non-monthly frequencies.

maandVanJaar.description: Month for annual recurrence; null for non-annual.

geldigVan.description: Effective start date. Weeks before this are ignored.

geldigTot.description: Expiration date; null if indefinite. Weeks after this are ignored.

accountNumberExpense.description: GL account code for the recurring cost (used on settlement). FK to Account.accountNumber.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

active.label: Active
active.description: Recurring item is being expanded into forecast horizons.

suspended.label: Suspended
suspended.description: Item temporarily skipped (e.g. payment pause negotiated with landlord).

ended.label: Ended
ended.description: geldigTot reached or contract terminated; no longer expanded.

suspend.label: Suspend recurring
suspend.description: Pause expansion. Used during payment hold negotiations.

CashflowBufferPolicy.title: Cashflow Buffer Policy
CashflowBufferPolicy.description: Operator-configurable minimum cash buffer for the business, with two-tier alert thresholds (VOORALARM at 150% of buffer, CRISIS at 50%). Buffer can be a fixed EUR amount, N months vaste kosten, or a custom formula. REQ-CF-009.

fixedAmount.description: Operator-supplied EUR amount when policy = MIN_FIXED_AMOUNT.

monthsVasteKosten.description: Number of months of vaste kosten when policy = MIN_MONTHS_VASTE_KOSTEN.

customFormula.description: Custom formula expression when policy = CUSTOM_FORMULA.

berekendeBuffer.description: Calculated buffer threshold in EUR (derived from policy).

alertOndergrens.description: Critical alert threshold (= 50% of berekendeBuffer by default).

alertVooralarm.description: Pre-alert threshold (= 150% of berekendeBuffer by default).

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

CashflowScenario.title: Cashflow Scenario
CashflowScenario.description: Immutable point-in-time what-if snapshot of a CashflowForecastHorizon with one or more adjustments (AR override, recurring pause, new revenue, buffer override). The forecast is recomputed against the snapshot, leaving the baseline unchanged. REQ-CF-011.

description.example: Acme delays invoice fact-2026-0247 by 4 weeks; assess buffer impact.

aanpassingen.description: Array of adjustment rules. Supported types: AR_PROJECTION_OVERRIDE, RECURRING_COST_ADJUSTMENT, NEW_REVENUE, BUFFER_POLICY_OVERRIDE. REQ-CF-011.

resultaat.description: Computed results after recomputing the horizon against the adjustments.

minBufferWeek.description: ISO week-number string of the lowest saldo week.

onderschrijdingBuffer.description: Whether the scenario breaches the buffer policy.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

CashflowCalibrationReport.title: Cashflow Calibration Report
CashflowCalibrationReport.description: Monthly post-month-end forecast-accuracy report comparing actual vs forecast by category (AR/AP/recurring/tax). MAPE-based, used to update customer betalingsgedrag offsets and pipeline-deal conversion probabilities. REQ-CF-013.

ar_mape.description: Mean Absolute Percentage Error for AR projections (%).

betalingsgedragUpdates.description: Customers whose betalingsgedrag offset was updated.

pipelineConversionUpdates.description: Pipelinq deals whose conversion probability was recalibrated.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration tenant.

FxRate.title: FX Rate
FxRate.description: Foreign exchange rate for a (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency, date, source) tuple. Orientation: 1 transactionCurrency = rate × baseCurrency, matching GLLine.fxRate — no reciprocation needed. ECB rates are stored inverted (our rate = 1 / ECB published rate) per REQ-MC-002.

transactionCurrency.description: The currency being converted FROM (the foreign/quote currency on a GL line). ISO 4217.

baseCurrency.description: The currency being converted TO (the administration's base currency). ISO 4217.

date.description: The day this rate applies to.

rate.description: Rate: 1 transactionCurrency = rate × baseCurrency. Same orientation as GLLine.fxRate. A USD/EUR row for '1 USD = 0.9259 EUR' stores rate: 0.9259. ECB feed inverted on ingest: our rate = 1 / ECB rate, rounded to ≥6 decimal places.

manualOverrideReason.description: Required when source = manual. Explains the business reason for overriding the ECB rate (e.g. internal hedge contract).

administrationId.description: Optional — when set, this rate applies only to the specified administration; when null the rate is global.

conditions.error: manualOverrideReason is required when source is manual

active.label: Active
active.description: Rate is valid and may be used for new GL postings.

superseded.label: Superseded
superseded.description: A newer rate for the same tuple has been stored; this rate is retained for audit trail.

supersede.label: Supersede
supersede.description: Mark this rate as superseded when a corrected rate is stored for the same tuple.

countBySource.description: Number of FX rate records per source (ecb, manual, internal-policy).

latestRatePerPair.description: Most recent rate date per (transactionCurrency, baseCurrency) pair.

AuditDocument.title: Audit Document
AuditDocument.description: A financial document participating in SiSa audit (invoice, purchase order, journal entry, payment). Every state transition triggers an immutable audit-trail event via OR's audit service per REQ-SISA-001 and REQ-SISA-003.

documentType.description: Type of financial document participating in SiSa audit.

glTransactionId.description: FK to the related GLTransaction (T1 general-ledger).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this document.

signingUser.description: Nextcloud user ID who signed or issued the document. Captured by OR audit service on the issued/signed transition.

signingTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the document was signed. Captured by OR audit service.

signingReason.description: Optional reason or comment on signing (e.g., 'approved per committee decision 2026-06-14').

state.description: Document signing state per REQ-SISA-004 lifecycle.

lifecycleState.description: Archival lifecycle state.

relatedTransactionAmount.description: Amount of the related GL transaction for context display.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for relatedTransactionAmount.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR audit service captures every state transition automatically (actor, timestamp, action, before/after state). No app-local event table per ADR-022 D2.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Document is being prepared. Not yet legally effective.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Document issued and legally effective. Awaiting authorised signature.

signed.label: Signed
signed.description: Document signed by authorised user. Immutable; captured in OR audit trail.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Document voided. Compensating GL posting required per T1 REQ-GL-004.

issue.label: Issue document
issue.description: Operator issues the document after validating format against the linked GL transaction.

sign.label: Sign document
sign.description: Authorised user signs the document. Signature authority verified per T2 authorization-mandate-management (deferred to T3 if not yet stable).

voidFromDraft.label: Void draft
voidFromDraft.description: Operator cancels the document before issuance.

voidFromSigned.label: Void signed document
voidFromSigned.description: Operator reverses a signed document. Requires compensating GL posting created per T1 REQ-GL-004.

ComplianceAuditTrail.title: Compliance Audit Trail
ComplianceAuditTrail.description: Auditor working log per administration tracking audit findings (critical/major/minor), governance observations, and remediation status per REQ-SISA-005. Referenced by SisaReport aggregation to compute finding counts and overall opinion.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration under audit.

findingNumber.description: Reference number of an individual audit finding.

findingDescription.description: Detailed description of the audit finding.
findingDescription.example: BTW-afdracht over Q3 2026 niet tijdig ingediend; €18.500 achterstalling.

observationNumber.description: Reference number of an individual governance observation.

observationDescription.example: Inkoopproces mist formele budgethouder-goedkeuring voor orders boven €10.000.

auditorName.description: Auditor or audit firm name responsible for this trail entry.

auditDate.description: Date of the audit fieldwork or finding issuance.

status.description: Status of this audit trail record.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Trail entry being compiled by auditor.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Trail entry submitted to management for acknowledgement.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Finding remediated or observation acknowledged; trail closed.

submit.label: Submit to management
submit.description: Auditor submits the finding or observation to management.

close.label: Close trail
close.description: Management acknowledges finding or remediation is complete.

DepreciationSchedule.title: Depreciation Schedule
DepreciationSchedule.description: Per-asset yearly depreciation tracking for a fixed asset. Declares method, annual rate, period boundaries, and calculated amounts. Immutable append-only per REQ-FA-003 and D4 (changes tracked via audit trail). Float Precision from Nextcloud System Settings applied at calculation time per REQ-FA-005.

scheduleNumber.description: Unique identifier for the depreciation schedule record.

depreciationMethod.description: Depreciation method applied in this schedule period.

annualRate.description: Annual depreciation rate as decimal (e.g. 0.20 = 20%) or fixed EUR amount per rateType.

periodStartDate.description: Start date of the depreciation period (typically fiscal year start).

periodEndDate.description: End date of the depreciation period (typically fiscal year end).

depreciationAmount.description: Depreciation amount for this period. Rounded to Float Precision setting (fallback: 2 decimal places per Dutch standard).

accumulatedDepreciation.description: Total depreciation accumulated across all periods to date.

bookValue.description: Net book value at period end = FixedAsset.purchaseCost − accumulatedDepreciation. Computed field; not stored independently.

costCenterCode.description: Cost center for depreciation allocation. Updated by internal asset transfer per REQ-FA-006.

administrationId.description: FK to the owning administration.

bookValue.description: Derived net book value per REQ-FA-003: FixedAsset.purchaseCost minus accumulatedDepreciation at period end.

depreciationAmount.description: Period depreciation amount computed per depreciationMethod with Float Precision rounding per REQ-FA-005.

depreciationByMethod.description: Sum of depreciation amounts grouped by method for current fiscal year per REQ-FA-009 item 1.

depreciationByCostCenter.description: Sum of depreciation amounts grouped by cost center for current fiscal year per REQ-FA-009 item 2.

accumulatedDepreciationByAsset.description: Cumulative depreciation across all periods per asset per REQ-FA-009 item 3.

bookValuesByStatus.description: Book values grouped by asset status for balance-sheet reporting per REQ-FA-009 item 4.

fixedAsset.description: The fixed asset this depreciation schedule belongs to.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: A financial grant or subsidy awarded to an organization under a subsidy scheme (WBSO, BBV, NSO, Tozo). Includes isSISAEligible flag per REQ-SISA-010 to control SiSa report aggregation filtering. Full grant lifecycle (application, disbursement, compliance) is declared by add-shillinq-grant-subsidy-management; this stub adds the SiSa eligibility field.

awardDate.description: Date the grant was formally awarded.

accountingStandard.description: Governmental accounting standard applied (e.g., BBV, RJ290).

isSISAEligible.description: Whether this grant requires Single Information Single Audit compliance per REQ-SISA-010. WBSO and BBV grants are eligible; Tozo and NSO grants are not.

ManagementLetter.title: Management Letter
ManagementLetter.description: Formal auditor-to-management communication documenting SiSa findings, observations, and remediation recommendations per REQ-SISA-006. T2 provides the data structure; T4 attaches external auditor signature and authority submission. Note: a ManagementLetter entity also exists in compliance-audit spec; reconciliation during T2/T4 implementing cycle will merge or disambiguate.

sisaReportId.description: FK to the SisaReport this letter belongs to.

auditorName.description: Auditor or audit firm name who issued this letter.

issuedDate.description: Date this management letter was issued.

dueResponseDate.description: Deadline for management to respond to the letter.

findingsSummary.description: Summary of audit findings included in this letter.
findingsSummary.example: 1 major bevinding (BTW-afdracht) en 3 mineure bevindingen aangetroffen in FY2026.

observationsSummary.example: Aanbeveling: versterking van het inkoopproces voor orders boven €10.000.

remediationRecommendations.description: Recommended corrective actions for identified findings.
remediationRecommendations.example: Herstel BTW-aangifte Q3 2026 vóór 31 maart 2027. Implementeer budgethouder-goedkeuring.

auditOpinion.description: Auditor's audit opinion as stated in this letter (pre-computed from SisaReport.auditOpinion).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Letter is being composed.

acknowledged.label: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Management has acknowledged receipt and committed to remediation.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Letter archived after remediation cycle completion.

issue.label: Issue letter
issue.description: Auditor formally issues the management letter.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Management acknowledges the letter and commits to action.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Archive letter after remediation cycle is complete.

SisaReport.title: SiSa Report
SisaReport.description: Single Information Single Audit (SiSa) compliance report per fiscal year per REQ-SISA-001. Aggregates transaction counts, on-time settlement %, audit findings, and overall audit opinion for Dutch government grant compliance (WBSO, BBV).

reportNumber.description: Unique report identifier per administration (e.g., SISA-2026-ADM001).

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year covered by this SiSa report (e.g., 2026).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this report belongs to.

reportDate.description: Date the report was generated or finalised.

totalTransactionCount.description: Total number of financial transactions in the fiscal period.

onTimeSettlementPercent.description: Percentage of obligations settled by their due date (0–100). Computed via x-openregister-aggregations.onTimeSettlement.

totalAmount.description: Total financial value of all transactions in the fiscal period (EUR).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this report.

criticalFindingsCount.description: Count of critical-severity audit findings from ComplianceAuditTrail.

observationsCount.description: Count of governance observations from ComplianceAuditTrail.

remediationOverdueCount.description: Count of remediation actions that are overdue (remediationDueDate < today AND remediationStatus != completed).

auditOpinion.description: Overall audit opinion per REQ-SISA-009: unqualified (0 findings), qualified (1-2 major), adverse (3+ major or any critical), disclaimer (any overdue remediation).

managementLetterId.description: FK to the ManagementLetter record associated with this report.

complianceStatus.description: Overall compliance status of the administration for this fiscal year.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of this SiSa report.

submissionDate.description: Date this report was submitted to the relevant authority.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Report is being compiled. Aggregation data may be incomplete.

finalized.label: Finalized
finalized.description: Audit opinion computed; report is ready for authority submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Report submitted to the relevant government authority.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical archive state; retained per audit-retention rules.

finalize.label: Finalize report
finalize.description: Lock aggregation data and compute audit opinion. Calls SisaReportingService::calculateAuditOpinion() per ADR-031 exception if OR conditional aggregations are not stable.

submit.label: Submit to authority
submit.description: Mark report as submitted to the government authority.

archive.label: Archive report
archive.description: Move to historical archive after authority acknowledgement.

reopen.label: Reopen for correction
reopen.description: Return finalized report to draft for correction (before submission only).

onTimeSettlement.description: On-time settlement compliance per REQ-SISA-007: COUNT(obligations settled by dueDate) / COUNT(all non-draft, non-voided obligations) * 100. Source: Obligation and Payment registers from T1 bookkeeping-general-ledger. Filters to isSISAEligible grants only.

findingCounts.description: Aggregate audit finding counts per REQ-SISA-008 from ComplianceAuditTrail. Groups by severity and counts overdue remediations.

auditOpinion.description: Declarative audit opinion rule per REQ-SISA-009. If OR conditional aggregations are not stable, OCA\Shillinq\Service\SisaReportingService::calculateAuditOpinion() implements the same rule as an ADR-031 exception.
auditOpinion.expression: IF remediationOverdueCount > 0 THEN 'disclaimer' ELSE IF criticalFindingsCount > 0 OR majorFindingsCount >= 3 THEN 'adverse' ELSE IF majorFindingsCount >= 1 THEN 'qualified' ELSE 'unqualified'

SisaReport.title: SiSa Report
SisaReport.description: Single Information Single Audit (SiSa) compliance report per fiscal year per REQ-SISA-001. Aggregates transaction counts, on-time settlement %, audit findings, and overall audit opinion for Dutch government grant compliance (WBSO, BBV).

reportNumber.description: Unique report identifier per administration (e.g., SISA-2026-ADM001).

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year covered by this SiSa report (e.g., 2026).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration this report belongs to.

reportDate.description: Date the report was generated or finalised.

totalTransactionCount.description: Total number of financial transactions in the fiscal period.

onTimeSettlementPercent.description: Percentage of obligations settled by their due date (0–100). Computed via x-openregister-aggregations.onTimeSettlement.

totalAmount.description: Total financial value of all transactions in the fiscal period (EUR).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this report.

criticalFindingsCount.description: Count of critical-severity audit findings from ComplianceAuditTrail.

observationsCount.description: Count of governance observations from ComplianceAuditTrail.

remediationOverdueCount.description: Count of remediation actions that are overdue (remediationDueDate < today AND remediationStatus != completed).

auditOpinion.description: Overall audit opinion per REQ-SISA-009: unqualified (0 findings), qualified (1-2 major), adverse (3+ major or any critical), disclaimer (any overdue remediation).

managementLetterId.description: FK to the ManagementLetter record associated with this report.

complianceStatus.description: Overall compliance status of the administration for this fiscal year.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of this SiSa report.

submissionDate.description: Date this report was submitted to the relevant authority.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Report is being compiled. Aggregation data may be incomplete.

finalized.label: Finalized
finalized.description: Audit opinion computed; report is ready for authority submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Report submitted to the relevant government authority.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical archive state; retained per audit-retention rules.

finalize.label: Finalize report
finalize.description: Lock aggregation data and compute audit opinion. Calls SisaReportingService::calculateAuditOpinion() per ADR-031 exception if OR conditional aggregations are not stable.

submit.label: Submit to authority
submit.description: Mark report as submitted to the government authority.

archive.label: Archive report
archive.description: Move to historical archive after authority acknowledgement.

reopen.label: Reopen for correction
reopen.description: Return finalized report to draft for correction (before submission only).

onTimeSettlement.description: On-time settlement compliance per REQ-SISA-007: COUNT(obligations settled by dueDate) / COUNT(all non-draft, non-voided obligations) * 100. Source: Obligation and Payment registers from T1 bookkeeping-general-ledger. Filters to isSISAEligible grants only.

findingCounts.description: Aggregate audit finding counts per REQ-SISA-008 from ComplianceAuditTrail. Groups by severity and counts overdue remediations.

auditOpinion.description: Declarative audit opinion rule per REQ-SISA-009. If OR conditional aggregations are not stable, OCA\Shillinq\Service\SisaReportingService::calculateAuditOpinion() implements the same rule as an ADR-031 exception.
auditOpinion.expression: IF remediationOverdueCount > 0 THEN 'disclaimer' ELSE IF criticalFindingsCount > 0 OR majorFindingsCount >= 3 THEN 'adverse' ELSE IF majorFindingsCount >= 1 THEN 'qualified' ELSE 'unqualified'

AuditDocument.title: Audit Document
AuditDocument.description: A financial document participating in SiSa audit (invoice, purchase order, journal entry, payment). Every state transition triggers an immutable audit-trail event via OR's audit service per REQ-SISA-001 and REQ-SISA-003.

documentType.description: Type of financial document participating in SiSa audit.

glTransactionId.description: FK to the related GLTransaction (T1 general-ledger).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this document.

signingUser.description: Nextcloud user ID who signed or issued the document. Captured by OR audit service on the issued/signed transition.

signingTimestamp.description: Timestamp when the document was signed. Captured by OR audit service.

signingReason.description: Optional reason or comment on signing (e.g., 'approved per committee decision 2026-06-14').

state.description: Document signing state per REQ-SISA-004 lifecycle.

lifecycleState.description: Archival lifecycle state.

relatedTransactionAmount.description: Amount of the related GL transaction for context display.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for relatedTransactionAmount.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: OR audit service captures every state transition automatically (actor, timestamp, action, before/after state). No app-local event table per ADR-022 D2.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Document is being prepared. Not yet legally effective.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Document issued and legally effective. Awaiting authorised signature.

signed.label: Signed
signed.description: Document signed by authorised user. Immutable; captured in OR audit trail.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Document voided. Compensating GL posting required per T1 REQ-GL-004.

issue.label: Issue document
issue.description: Operator issues the document after validating format against the linked GL transaction.

sign.label: Sign document
sign.description: Authorised user signs the document. Signature authority verified per T2 authorization-mandate-management (deferred to T3 if not yet stable).

voidFromDraft.label: Void draft
voidFromDraft.description: Operator cancels the document before issuance.

voidFromSigned.label: Void signed document
voidFromSigned.description: Operator reverses a signed document. Requires compensating GL posting created per T1 REQ-GL-004.

ComplianceAuditTrail.title: Compliance Audit Trail
ComplianceAuditTrail.description: Auditor working log per administration tracking audit findings (critical/major/minor), governance observations, and remediation status per REQ-SISA-005. Referenced by SisaReport aggregation to compute finding counts and overall opinion.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration under audit.

findingNumber.description: Reference number of an individual audit finding.

findingDescription.description: Detailed description of the audit finding.
findingDescription.example: BTW-afdracht over Q3 2026 niet tijdig ingediend; €18.500 achterstalling.

observationNumber.description: Reference number of an individual governance observation.

observationDescription.example: Inkoopproces mist formele budgethouder-goedkeuring voor orders boven €10.000.

auditorName.description: Auditor or audit firm name responsible for this trail entry.

auditDate.description: Date of the audit fieldwork or finding issuance.

status.description: Status of this audit trail record.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Trail entry being compiled by auditor.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Trail entry submitted to management for acknowledgement.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Finding remediated or observation acknowledged; trail closed.

submit.label: Submit to management
submit.description: Auditor submits the finding or observation to management.

close.label: Close trail
close.description: Management acknowledges finding or remediation is complete.

ManagementLetter.title: Management Letter
ManagementLetter.description: Formal auditor-to-management communication documenting SiSa findings, observations, and remediation recommendations per REQ-SISA-006. T2 provides the data structure; T4 attaches external auditor signature and authority submission. Note: a ManagementLetter entity also exists in compliance-audit spec; reconciliation during T2/T4 implementing cycle will merge or disambiguate.

sisaReportId.description: FK to the SisaReport this letter belongs to.

auditorName.description: Auditor or audit firm name who issued this letter.

issuedDate.description: Date this management letter was issued.

dueResponseDate.description: Deadline for management to respond to the letter.

findingsSummary.description: Summary of audit findings included in this letter.
findingsSummary.example: 1 major bevinding (BTW-afdracht) en 3 mineure bevindingen aangetroffen in FY2026.

observationsSummary.example: Aanbeveling: versterking van het inkoopproces voor orders boven €10.000.

remediationRecommendations.description: Recommended corrective actions for identified findings.
remediationRecommendations.example: Herstel BTW-aangifte Q3 2026 vóór 31 maart 2027. Implementeer budgethouder-goedkeuring.

auditOpinion.description: Auditor's audit opinion as stated in this letter (pre-computed from SisaReport.auditOpinion).

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Letter is being composed.
