acknowledged.label: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Management has acknowledged receipt and committed to remediation.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Letter archived after remediation cycle completion.

issue.label: Issue letter
issue.description: Auditor formally issues the management letter.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Management acknowledges the letter and commits to action.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Archive letter after remediation cycle is complete.

Grant.title: Grant
Grant.description: A financial grant or subsidy awarded to an organization under a subsidy scheme (WBSO, BBV, NSO, Tozo). Includes isSISAEligible flag per REQ-SISA-010 to control SiSa report aggregation filtering. Full grant lifecycle (application, disbursement, compliance) is declared by add-shillinq-grant-subsidy-management; this stub adds the SiSa eligibility field.

awardDate.description: Date the grant was formally awarded.

accountingStandard.description: Governmental accounting standard applied (e.g., BBV, RJ290).

isSISAEligible.description: Whether this grant requires Single Information Single Audit compliance per REQ-SISA-010. WBSO and BBV grants are eligible; Tozo and NSO grants are not.

VendorMaster.title: Vendor
VendorMaster.description: Vendor party record for accounts payable. Holds bank IBAN, payment terms, tax registration, and dunning-policy reference for a vendor within a single administration. Per REQ-AP-002.

vendorNumber.description: Stable vendor identifier unique per administration.

iban.description: Default IBAN for outgoing payments to this vendor.

bic.description: BIC/SWIFT code matching the IBAN bank.

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets APInvoice.dueDate on creation).

defaultExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default expense coding on AP invoices.

email.description: Primary contact email for invoice queries.

dunningPolicyId.description: FK to OR dunning-workflow policy record if the extension is stable per ADR-022; else null.

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this vendor record.

lifecycleState.description: Vendor master lifecycle state. blocked: payments suspended; archived: historical reference only.

active.label: Active
active.description: Vendor is active; AP invoices may be created and paid.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Vendor is blocked; new AP invoices cannot transition to approved or posted.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Vendor is archived for historical reference; no new invoices may be created.

archive.label: Archive vendor
archive.description: Archive vendor after all open AP invoices are settled.

APInvoice.title: AP Invoice
APInvoice.description: Accounts payable sub-ledger invoice recording vendor billing and payment obligation. Posting materialises a balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007. Lifecycle: draft → pending → approved → posted → paid with disputed/voided branches. Approval routing consumes OR approval-workflow per ADR-022. Per REQ-AP-003 and REQ-AP-004.

vendorInvoiceRef.description: The vendor's own invoice number as it appears on the paper/PDF invoice.

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from invoiceDate + vendor.paymentTermDays; overrideable by operator.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only; T5 adds multi-currency.

totalAmount.description: Total amount including tax. Credit notes are separate journal types, not negative totals.

taxAmount.description: VAT/BTW amount. T3 adds automated VAT posting; T2 carries the field for reporting.

lines.description: Invoice line breakdown. Each line maps to one GL expense account.

taxCode.description: Tax code for this line (e.g. BTW21, BTW9, BTW0).

quantity.description: Quantity ordered/received (required for 3-way match when PO/GR present).

unitPrice.description: Unit price (required for 3-way match quantity parity check).

sourceDocumentUri.description: docudesk FK URI per bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration. Points to the scanned vendor invoice PDF.

purchaseOrderRef.description: FK to PO register UUID (future T4 procurement; nullable in T2). Declared so T4 attaches additively per REQ-AP-006.

goodsReceiptRef.description: FK to Goods Receipt register UUID (future T4; nullable in T2). Declared so T4 attaches additively per REQ-AP-006.

approvalState.description: OR approval-workflow state mirror per REQ-AP-005. Tracks the approval routing status.

state.description: AP invoice lifecycle state per REQ-AP-004.

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once the invoice is posted.

idealLink.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for GL posting (resolved on post transition per REQ-AP-004).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this AP invoice.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

pending.label: Pending approval
pending.description: Submitted for approval. Awaiting OR approval-workflow decision.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by authorised approver(s). Ready for posting.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. GL transaction materialised. Awaiting payment matching.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank reconciliation or PaymentRun.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Payment held; under investigation. Operator records investigation note.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Voided. Corresponding GLTransaction must already be reversed.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Operator submits the draft invoice for approval routing via OR approval-workflow per REQ-AP-005.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Approved by authorised approver(s) via OR approval-workflow. Sets approvalState: approved.

reject.label: Reject (return to draft)
reject.description: Approver rejects; sets approvalState: rejected and returns invoice to draft for operator revision.

post.label: Post
post.description: Post the invoice. Guards: (1) 3-way match per REQ-AP-006 (conditional on PO/GR presence); (2) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004. Action: materialise balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern.

actions.description: Emit one balanced GLTransaction with debit to expense accounts per lines and credit to AP control account (Account.isAPControlAccount = true) per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern. Sets glTransactionId back-reference.

matchPaid.label: Mark as paid
matchPaid.description: Transition to paid when bank-reconciliation engine matches an exact-amount bank statement line per REQ-AP-008. No shillinq matcher service — OR event-driven.

dispute.label: Raise dispute
dispute.description: Operator places payment hold pending investigation.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Operator resolves dispute; invoice returns to posted awaiting payment.

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted invoice. Guard: the materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

idealLink.expression: ideal.generatePaymentLink({invoiceNumber: invoiceNumber, amount: totalAmount, currency: currency, vendorRef: vendorInvoiceRef})
idealLink.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link generated by the OR calculations engine per REQ-AP-007. Populated automatically when the invoice is included in a PaymentRun with paymentMethod=ideal.

apAging.label: AP Aging
apAging.description: Groups open AP invoices by vendor and aging bucket per REQ-AP-009. Excludes paid and voided invoices.

PaymentRun.title: Payment Run
PaymentRun.description: Operator-curated batch of selected APInvoice UUIDs with SEPA pain.001 XML and iDEAL link outputs generated as x-openregister-calculations fields. No PaymentRunService or SepaXmlBuilder PHP classes per ADR-031. Per REQ-AP-007.

runNumber.description: Sequential payment run identifier per administration.

invoiceRefs.description: List of APInvoice UUIDs to include in this payment run.

totalAmount.description: Sum of selected invoices' totalAmount (x-openregister-calculations output).

paymentMethod.description: Payment method for this run. Determines which calculation output is populated.

sepaXml.description: SEPA pain.001.001.03 XML document (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=sepa-pain001. Operator downloads and uploads to bank portal.

idealLinks.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment links (x-openregister-calculations output per REQ-AP-007). Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this payment run.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Operator selects invoices and configures the run.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: SEPA XML or iDEAL links generated. Ready for download / submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Operator has uploaded the SEPA file or shared iDEAL links.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Run failed (e.g. bank rejection). Operator must investigate and retry.

prepare.label: Generate payment file
prepare.description: Triggers x-openregister-calculations to compose sepaXml (pain.001.001.03) or idealLinks per paymentMethod selection.

submit.label: Mark as submitted
submit.description: Operator confirms upload to bank portal or dispatch of iDEAL links.

execute.label: Mark as executed
execute.description: Bank confirms payment execution (or bank reconciliation auto-matches).

fail.label: Mark as failed
fail.description: Bank rejects the payment file or iDEAL transaction.

retry.label: Retry (return to draft)
retry.description: Return to draft for operator to correct and re-generate.

totalAmount.description: Sum of selected APInvoice totals, computed on save per REQ-AP-007.

sepaXml.expression: sepa.composePain001({invoiceRefs: invoiceRefs, runDate: runDate, schemaVersion: 'pain.001.001.03', administrationId: administrationId})
sepaXml.description: SEPA pain.001.001.03 XML document composed from selected invoice vendor IBANs, amounts, and run date per REQ-AP-007. Populated when paymentMethod=sepa-pain001.

idealLinks.expression: invoiceRefs.map(id => ideal.generatePaymentLink({invoiceRef: id, amount: APInvoice[id].totalAmount, currency: APInvoice[id].currency}))
idealLinks.description: Per-invoice iDEAL payment link array per REQ-AP-007. Populated when paymentMethod=ideal.

CustomerMaster.title: Customer
CustomerMaster.description: Customer party record for accounts receivable. Holds billing address, payment terms, tax registration, credit limit, dunning-policy reference, and Peppol endpoint for outbound e-invoicing within a single administration. Per REQ-AR-002.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping master register; every create / update / delete is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022.

customerNumber.description: Stable customer identifier unique per administration.

paymentTermDays.description: Default payment term in days (auto-sets ARInvoice.dueDate on creation).

defaultRevenueAccountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber for default revenue coding on AR invoices.

creditLimit.description: Credit limit in administration's base currency. When > 0, REQ-AR-006 evaluates SUM(open ARInvoice.totalAmount where customerId=this.id) against this value on draft AR invoices.

dunningPolicyRef.description: FK to OR dunning-workflow policy record if the extension is stable per ADR-022; else null. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.

peppolEndpoint.description: Peppol BIS 3.0 endpoint identifier for outbound e-invoicing (consumed by T4 e-invoicing capability; declared in T2 so T4 attaches additively per REQ-AR-009). Format: scheme::value (e.g. 0106::12345678 for Dutch KvK).

address.description: Postal billing address of the customer.

email.description: Primary billing email for invoice dispatch and dunning notifications.

contactRef.description: FK to OR contact abstraction if stable per ADR-022; else null. Symmetric to AP REQ-AP-002. Resolution deferred to implementing cycle.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this customer record.

lifecycleState.description: Customer master lifecycle state. blocked: new invoices cannot be issued; archived: historical reference only.

active.label: Active
active.description: Customer is active; AR invoices may be issued.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Customer is blocked; new AR invoices cannot transition from draft to issued.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Customer is archived for historical reference; no new invoices may be drafted.

block.label: Block customer
block.description: Suspend new invoicing for this customer (e.g. credit hold).

archive.label: Archive customer
archive.description: Archive customer after all open AR invoices are settled or written off.

ARInvoice.title: AR Invoice
ARInvoice.description: Accounts receivable sub-ledger invoice recording customer billing and revenue recognition. Issuing materialises a balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 (debit AR control, credit revenue per lines). Lifecycle: draft → issued → paid with partially-paid / overdue / disputed / written-off / voided branches per REQ-AR-004. Carries UBL 2.1 / Peppol BIS 3.0 field shape declared but NOT computed in T2 — T4 e-invoicing populates ublXml + peppolDispatchedAt additively per REQ-AR-009. Per REQ-AR-003 and REQ-AR-004.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping sub-ledger register; every lifecycle transition (issue / overdue / match / dispute / write-off / void) and every header / line edit is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Audit trail is the canonical evidence chain for the AR write-off scenario per REQ-AR-007.

invoiceNumber.description: Shillinq-side invoice number (auto-generated per administration). Unique per administration.

dueDate.description: Auto-calculated from invoiceDate + customer.paymentTermDays; overrideable by operator.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. T2: base currency only; T5 adds multi-currency.

totalAmount.description: Total amount including tax. Credit notes are separate journal types, not negative totals.

taxAmount.description: VAT/BTW amount. T3 adds automated VAT posting; T2 carries the field for reporting.

lines.description: Invoice line breakdown. Each line maps to one GL revenue account. Per bookkeeping-invoice-vat-kassakoppeling REQ-VAT-001 each line additionally carries vatRate (21|9|6|0), vatAmount (decimal euros computed via bankerRound), and serviceCategory (product|service|exempt) gating REQ-VAT-002 validation.

amount.description: Line amount (non-negative; see REQ-AR-003). Net of VAT; the per-line VAT is stored separately in vatAmount per REQ-VAT-001.

taxCode.description: Tax code for this line (e.g. BTW21, BTW9, BTW0). Pre-VAT-spec free-form field retained for legacy compatibility; new VAT logic uses the structured vatRate field per REQ-VAT-001.

vatRate.description: Per-line Dutch VAT rate in percent (REQ-VAT-001). Defaults to the administration's standard rate (typically 21). REQ-VAT-002 precondition gates which rates are permitted for each serviceCategory.

vatAmount.description: Per-line VAT in decimal euros (REQ-VAT-001). Computed as bankerRound(amount * vatRate / 100, 2) per REQ-VAT-007. Sum of per-line vatAmount populates ARInvoice.taxAmount; no invoice-level rounding adjustment line is emitted.

serviceCategory.description: Per-line service / product / exempt classification gating VAT rate validity (REQ-VAT-002). product permits {0,6,21}; service permits {0,9,21}; exempt permits only 0. Exceptions are recorded in ServiceCategoryOverride per REQ-VAT-002bis.

sourceDocumentUri.description: docudesk FK URI per bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration. Points to the issued invoice PDF.

ublXml.description: UBL 2.1 / Peppol BIS 3.0 XML representation. Declared in T2 but NOT computed in T2 — T4 e-invoicing populates this field via additional x-openregister-calculations per REQ-AR-009. Always null in T2.

peppolDispatchedAt.description: Timestamp of Peppol dispatch. Set by T4 e-invoicing capability; always null in T2 per REQ-AR-009.

state.description: AR invoice lifecycle state per REQ-AR-004.

glTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the materialised GLTransaction once the invoice is issued.

writeOffReason.description: Operator-authored audit-trailed reason for write-off. Required on the writeOff lifecycle transition per REQ-AR-007.
writeOffReason.example: Customer insolvency, court-confirmed uncollectible per ruling 2026-04-22.

writeOffGlTransactionId.description: Back-reference to the compensating GLTransaction emitted on write-off (debit bad-debt expense, credit AR control) per REQ-AR-007.

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod for GL posting (resolved on issue transition per REQ-AR-004).

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this AR invoice.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines and header fields may be edited.

issued.label: Issued
issued.description: Immutable header. GL transaction materialised; awaiting payment match.

partially-paid.label: Partially paid
partially-paid.description: One or more bank-reconciliation matches have applied but cumulative matched amount is less than totalAmount.

paid.label: Paid
paid.description: Full payment matched via bank-reconciliation engine. Terminal state for the happy path.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: today > dueDate and no full payment match yet. OR's dunning-workflow drives REQ-AR-005 reminder cadence from this state.

disputed.label: Disputed
disputed.description: Operator placed payment-match pursuit on hold pending customer-raised dispute investigation.

written-off.label: Written off
written-off.description: Bad-debt write-off; compensating GL posting emitted per REQ-AR-007. Terminal state.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Issued invoice voided. The materialised issue GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

issue.label: Issue invoice
issue.description: Issue the AR invoice. Guards: (1) FiscalPeriod open per REQ-PC-004; (2) balance guard (T1 REQ-JE-007); (3) credit-limit precondition per REQ-AR-006 — evaluated against the customerOpenArBalance aggregation; emits a warning by default, hard-block when administration policy sets requires.creditLimit.mode='block'; (4) per-line service-category VAT-rate gate per bookkeeping-invoice-vat-kassakoppeling REQ-VAT-002 (consults ServiceCategoryOverride before rejecting per REQ-VAT-002bis); (5) VATGLAccounts configured for the administration per REQ-VAT-006 (actionable error message + deep link per REQ-VAT-008). Actions: (a) materialise one balanced GLTransaction per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern with revenue + VATPayable21/9/6/0 credits per REQ-VAT-003; (b) append one VATAuditRecord per line with lifecycleEvent=issued and settlementPeriod bound from invoiceDate + administration.vatFilingFrequency per REQ-VAT-004 + REQ-VAT-005. Sets glTransactionId back-reference.

messageTemplate.nl: Kredietlimiet overschreden: open AR €{{openBalance}} + factuur €{{totalAmount}} = €{{projectedBalance}} > limiet €{{creditLimit}} voor klant {{customerNumber}}.
messageTemplate.en: Credit limit exceeded: open AR €{{openBalance}} + invoice €{{totalAmount}} = €{{projectedBalance}} > limit €{{creditLimit}} for customer {{customerNumber}}.

preconditions.description: REQ-AR-006 declarative aggregation predicate. Aggregates customer's open AR balance (sum of totalAmount for state in issued/partially-paid/overdue/disputed) and compares against CustomerMaster.creditLimit. Pure x-openregister-aggregations per ADR-031; no CreditLimitService PHP class.

preconditions.predicate: this.vatRate IN defaultMatrix[this.serviceCategory] OR EXISTS(ServiceCategoryOverride WHERE administrationId=ARInvoice.administrationId AND serviceCategory=this.serviceCategory AND vatRate=this.vatRate)

messageTemplate.nl: Regel {{lineSequence}}: servicecategorie '{{serviceCategory}}' staat geen BTW-tarief {{vatRate}}% toe. Controleer de admin-instellingen voor servicecategorie-uitzonderingen.
messageTemplate.en: Line {{lineSequence}}: Service category '{{serviceCategory}}' does not permit {{vatRate}}% VAT. Check admin settings for service-category overrides.

preconditions.description: REQ-VAT-002 + REQ-VAT-002bis: validates every line's vatRate against the serviceCategory matrix; consults ServiceCategoryOverride before rejecting. Pure declarative predicate per ADR-031; no PHP VAT validator service. When an override authorises the line, the resulting VATAuditRecord stores overrideId for audit traceability per REQ-VAT-004.

messageTemplate.nl: Kan factuur niet uitgeven: BTW-grootboekrekeningen zijn niet geconfigureerd voor deze administratie. Ga naar Instellingen > Boekhouding > BTW-configuratie om de vier BTW-grootboekrekeningen toe te wijzen.
messageTemplate.en: Cannot issue invoice: VAT GL accounts not configured for administration. Go to Settings > Accounting > Tax Configuration to assign VAT GL accounts.

preconditions.description: REQ-VAT-006 + REQ-VAT-008: ensures the administration has configured the four VATPayable* GL accounts before VAT accrual materialises. The actionable error message + deep link guide the operator straight to the Tax Configuration admin panel.

actions.description: Emit one balanced GLTransaction with debit to AR control account (Account.isARControlAccount = true), credit to revenue accounts per lines per T1 REQ-JE-007 pattern, and credit to VATPayable21/9/6/0 per rate bucket per REQ-VAT-003 (account numbers resolved from VATGLAccounts for the administration). Sets glTransactionId back-reference; sets GLLine.subLedgerType=ar + GLLine.subLedgerRef=<ARInvoice UUID> per REQ-AR-001.

Per REQ-VAT-004 + REQ-VAT-005: append one VATAuditRecord per ARInvoice line with lifecycleEvent='issued', settlementPeriod bound from invoiceDate + administration.vatFilingFrequency (monthly|quarterly|annual), and immutable copies of (lineSequence, lineDescription, lineAmount, vatRate, vatAmount, serviceCategory). When the line was authorised under a ServiceCategoryOverride, the matching override's id is captured on overrideId. Pure declarative materialisation per ADR-031; no app-local VAT-audit service.

markOverdue.label: Mark overdue
markOverdue.description: Scheduled OR ScheduledWorkflow tick when today > dueDate and no payment match has cleared totalAmount. Per ADR-031 §'Background jobs that walk an object queue' path 2 — no shillinq *Job PHP class.

matchPartial.label: Mark partially paid
matchPartial.description: Event-driven transition fired when bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation emits a confirmed ReconciliationMatch (targetType=ar-invoice, targetId=this.id) per REQ-BR-006 AND the cumulative matched amount for this invoice is greater than 0 but less than totalAmount. Operator confirms the candidate match in bank-reconciliation UI; the lifecycle engine consumes the OR-native event. No shillinq matcher service per REQ-AR-009-bis; symmetric to AP matchPaid (REQ-AP-008).

trigger.condition: 0 < SUM(ReconciliationMatch.amount WHERE targetType='ar-invoice' AND targetId=this.id AND state='confirmed') < this.totalAmount

actions.description: Append a partial-payment audit-trail event capturing the ReconciliationMatch UUID, matched amount, cumulative paid amount, and remaining balance for REQ-AR-009-bis scenario 'partial payment yields partially-paid state'.

matchPaid.label: Mark paid
matchPaid.description: Event-driven transition fired when bookkeeping-bank-reconciliation emits a confirmed ReconciliationMatch (targetType=ar-invoice, targetId=this.id) per REQ-BR-006 AND the cumulative matched amount equals totalAmount. Operator confirms the candidate match in bank-reconciliation UI; the lifecycle engine consumes the OR-native event. No shillinq matcher service per REQ-AR-009-bis; symmetric to AP matchPaid (REQ-AP-008).

trigger.condition: SUM(ReconciliationMatch.amount WHERE targetType='ar-invoice' AND targetId=this.id AND state='confirmed') >= this.totalAmount

actions.description: Append a paid audit-trail event capturing the ReconciliationMatch UUID(s), final matched amount, and the bank statement line refs that cleared the invoice for REQ-AR-009-bis scenario 'exact-amount bank line marks invoice paid'.

dispute.label: Raise dispute
dispute.description: Operator places payment-match pursuit on hold pending customer-raised dispute investigation. Dunning escalation pauses while in disputed state.

resolveDispute.label: Resolve dispute
resolveDispute.description: Operator resolves the dispute; invoice returns to issued and dunning escalation resumes.

writeOff.label: Write off
writeOff.description: Operator in role controller declares the invoice uncollectible. Requires writeOffReason for audit-trail. Action: materialise a balanced compensating GLTransaction (debit bad-debt expense, credit AR control) for the residual open balance per REQ-AR-007. Sets writeOffGlTransactionId back-reference.

actions.description: Emit one balanced compensating GLTransaction with debit to bad-debt expense account (Account.isBadDebtExpenseAccount=true) and credit to AR control account (Account.isARControlAccount=true) for the invoice's residual open balance per REQ-AR-007. Sets writeOffGlTransactionId back-reference; sets GLLine.subLedgerType=ar + GLLine.subLedgerRef=<ARInvoice UUID> + GLLine.description='AR write-off: <writeOffReason>' for audit-trail traceability. The amount written off equals totalAmount minus cumulative matched payments (the residual open balance).

void.label: Void
void.description: Void a posted-and-issued invoice. Guard: the materialised GLTransaction MUST already be reversed per T1 REQ-GL-004.

customerOpenArBalance.label: Customer open AR balance
customerOpenArBalance.description: REQ-AR-006 declarative aggregation: sum of open AR exposure per customer. Consumed as the predicate basis for the credit-limit precondition on ARInvoice.issue. Excludes paid / written-off / voided invoices. Pure aggregation per ADR-031; no CreditLimitService PHP class.

openBalance.description: Sum of totalAmount across the customer's open AR invoices (states: issued, partially-paid, overdue, disputed).

openCount.description: Count of open AR invoices for the customer.

arAging.label: AR Aging
arAging.description: REQ-AR-008 declarative aggregation: groups open AR invoices by (customerId, agingBucket) where agingBucket is computed from (today - dueDate) thresholds. Excludes paid / voided / written-off invoices. Pure aggregation per ADR-031; no ARAgingReportService PHP class. Symmetric to AP apAging (REQ-AP-009).

customer.description: FK to the CustomerMaster record this invoice bills.

glTransaction.description: Back-reference to the materialised issue GLTransaction.

writeOffGlTransaction.description: Back-reference to the compensating write-off GLTransaction per REQ-AR-007.

dunningRecords.description: Dunning timeline rows for this invoice per REQ-AR-005.

DunningRecord.title: Dunning Record
DunningRecord.description: Per-invoice dunning timeline record capturing one reminder, formal notice, or collection escalation dispatched against an overdue ARInvoice. Append-only timeline; new rows are written by OR's dunning-workflow engine (or by the conditional DunningGuard fallback per ADR-031 exception if OR's extension is not yet stable). Shillinq carries no app-local dunning service per REQ-AR-005. Per REQ-AR-005.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Bookkeeping evidence register; every dispatch is recorded on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per REQ-AT-001 + ADR-022. Forms the per-invoice dunning evidence chain for incassowet / aanmaningsprocedure compliance.

reminderLevel.description: Dunning step. reminder-1 (default +14 days), reminder-2 (default +30 days), formal-notice (default +45 days; aanmaning), collection (default +60 days; doorgegeven aan incassobureau). Cadence is configurable per administration policy per REQ-AR-005.

dispatchedAt.description: When this dunning step was dispatched.

dispatchedBy.description: Actor that dispatched the dunning step. 'system' for the scheduled-workflow tick; otherwise the operator NC uid.

channel.description: Channel used to deliver the dunning notice. Defaults to email; post / phone capture operator-logged contact attempts.

templateRef.description: FK to OR's notification template used for this dispatch (per ADR-022). Resolution deferred to implementing cycle if OR's notification-template abstraction is not yet stable.

payload.description: Snapshot of the rendered message for audit traceability (subject + body excerpt + recipient). Operator-readable; not used for re-dispatch.

escalationLevel.description: 1-based escalation counter for this invoice (1 = first reminder, 2 = second, …). Surfaces on the AR detail page dunning timeline.

acknowledgedAt.description: When the customer responded (operator-logged or portal-captured). Pauses further dunning escalation per OR's dunning-workflow policy when set within a configured response window.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this dunning record.

invoice.description: FK to the parent ARInvoice this dunning record belongs to.

VATAuditRecord.title: VAT Audit Record
VATAuditRecord.description: Kassakoppeling-compliant per-line VAT audit record per bookkeeping-invoice-vat-kassakoppeling REQ-VAT-004. Append-only timeline: one immutable record per ARInvoice line per lifecycle event (issued, paid, written_off, reversed). All amounts are decimal-euros copies taken at event time, never mutated after creation. The schema is created by the ARInvoice.issue lifecycle materialisation (and follow-up paid / written-off / reversed transitions) per ADR-031 declarative-first; no app-local PHP VAT-audit service exists per the spec's ADR-031 anti-pattern enumeration. Belastingdienst audits inspect these records directly via OR's generic CRUD API.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Kassakoppeling immutable VAT audit channel. REQ-VAT-004 mandates append-only semantics; RBAC roles below grant only create + read (no update / delete). PATCH or DELETE against an existing record MUST return 409 SCHEMA_IMMUTABLE per ADR-022.

invoiceNumber.description: ARInvoice.invoiceNumber at the time of the captured event. Immutable copy.

lineSequence.description: 1-based index of the line within ARInvoice.lines[].

lineDescription.description: Immutable copy of ARInvoice.lines[lineSequence-1].description at event time.

lineAmount.description: Immutable copy of ARInvoice.lines[lineSequence-1].amount in decimal euros (mirrors AR T2 convention).

vatRate.description: VAT rate applied to this line at event time per REQ-VAT-001.

vatAmount.description: Immutable copy of the line's vatAmount in decimal euros at event time; banker's-rounded to 2 decimals per REQ-VAT-007.

serviceCategory.description: Immutable copy of the line's serviceCategory at event time per REQ-VAT-002.

lifecycleEvent.description: Which ARInvoice lifecycle transition this record captures. issued: VAT accrual on first issue (REQ-VAT-003). paid: payment match cleared via bank-reconciliation. written_off: bad-debt write-off (REQ-AR-007). reversed: compensating reversal / credit note.

eventDate.description: Timestamp the lifecycle event was recorded. UTC. Immutable.

paymentDate.description: Populated only when lifecycleEvent=paid; date of the matched payment.

settlementPeriod.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod (periodId) bound at issue time per REQ-VAT-005. Immutable once set; survives subsequent administration.vatFilingFrequency reconfigurations.

overrideId.description: Optional FK to ServiceCategoryOverride if this line's vatRate / serviceCategory combination was authorised under an exception per REQ-VAT-002bis.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this audit record.

invoice.description: FK to the ARInvoice the audit record belongs to. The number is a stable business key; immutable once issued.

fiscalPeriod.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod bound at issue time per REQ-VAT-005.

override.description: Optional link to the ServiceCategoryOverride consulted at issue time per REQ-VAT-002bis.

vatByPeriod.description: REQ-VAT-009 declarative aggregation: VAT totals broken down by rate for a given (administrationId, settlementPeriod) tuple, restricted to lifecycleEvent=issued so reversed records do not double-count. Powers the VATByPeriod manifest entry per REQ-VAT-010.
vatByPeriod.description2: Pure aggregation per ADR-031; no app-local VAT-by-period service.

ServiceCategoryOverride.title: Service Category Override
ServiceCategoryOverride.description: Per-administration exception to the default REQ-VAT-002 service-category / VAT-rate matrix. Append-only register; createdAt + createdBy are immutable once written. Lookup by (administrationId, serviceCategory, vatRate); the ARInvoice.issue precondition (REQ-VAT-002) consults this register before rejecting a non-default combination per REQ-VAT-002bis.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: VAT exception register; every override creation is audit-trailed on the OR audit-trail-immutable channel per ADR-022. The audit chain proves rare-rate authorisations to the Belastingdienst.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning the override.

serviceCategory.description: The serviceCategory the override applies to.

vatRate.description: The vatRate the override permits for the serviceCategory.

reason.description: Operator-authored audit reason. Retained for Belastingdienst inspection; free text.
reason.example: Special consulting agreement per contract X-2026

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the creator; immutable.

VATGLAccounts.title: VAT GL Accounts
VATGLAccounts.description: Per-administration mapping from VAT rate to the GL liability (VATPayable*) account credited by the ARInvoice.issue lifecycle action per REQ-VAT-006. One record per administrationId. Defaults from the RGS (Referentie Grootboekschema) chart (vat21=2020, vat9=2021, vat6=2022, vat0=2023) and seeded on installer first-run.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Configuration register; every reassignment of the four VAT GL accounts is audit-trailed per ADR-022. Prior balances on previously-used accounts remain unchanged.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; one VATGLAccounts record per administration.

vat21Account.description: GL account number credited for 21% VAT lines. Default 2020 per RGS baseline. MUST exist in Account for the administration.

vat9Account.description: GL account number credited for 9% VAT lines. Default 2021. MUST exist in Account for the administration.

vat6Account.description: GL account number credited for 6% VAT lines. Default 2022. MUST exist in Account for the administration.

vat0Account.description: GL account number credited for 0% / exempt VAT lines. Default 2023. MUST exist in Account for the administration.

Subsidie.title: Subsidie
Subsidie.description: Grant/subsidie record covering the full ASV-model lifecycle (aanvraag → verleend → vastgesteld → uitbetaald). Works for both outgoing grants (gemeente to beneficiary) and incoming grants (beneficiary from granting body). The subsidieRegeling enum field overlays per-regeling R&D constraints (REQ-RDS-001). schema:Grant annotation; schema:ResearchProject materialisation when subsidieRegeling indicates an R&D regeling. Per bookkeeping-subsidie-verantwoording + bookkeeping-r-d-subsidies-mkb.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this subsidie record.

direction.description: outgoing: this administration grants to a beneficiary. incoming: this administration receives from a granting body.

subsidieNumber.description: Unique subsidie identifier per administration and fiscal year.

counterpartyName.description: Beneficiary name (outgoing) or granting body name (incoming).

counterpartyId.description: FK to a contact record if available.

regelingArtikel.description: Specific article reference within the regeling.

subsidieRegeling.description: R&D subsidie regeling variant. When set, per-regeling kostencategorie constraints (REQ-RDS-002) apply to linked Kostenpost records. Per REQ-RDS-001.

verleendBedrag.description: Granted amount set on verleen transition.

vastgesteldBedrag.description: Settled amount set on vaststel transition.

uitbetaaldBedrag.description: Paid amount set on uitbetaal transition.

teruggevorderdBedrag.description: Reclaimed amount set on terugvorder transition.

beschikkingUri.description: docudesk URI of the verleningsbeschikking PDF.

vaststellingUri.description: docudesk URI of the vaststellingsbeschikking PDF.

voortgangsrapportage.description: Groups Kostenpost records per kostencategorie and periodId for the parent subsidie. Consumed by per-regeling docudesk voortgangsrapportage templates. Per REQ-RDS-003.

budgetMonitoringByCategory.description: Aggregates total approved amount per kostencategorie. Feeds per-regeling sub-max calculations (REQ-RDS-005).

horizonDirectCosts.description: Sum of approved direct-category kostenpost amounts for EU-Horizon subsidies. Basis for indirect-25% cap. Per REQ-RDS-005.

horizonIndirect25MaxBedrag.description: Maximum allowed indirect-25-percent amount: 25% of direct costs per EC Grant Agreement Art. 6(2). Per REQ-RDS-005.

horizonIndirect25UsageBedrag.description: Current approved total of indirect-25-percent kostenposten. Per REQ-RDS-005.

horizonIndirect25UsagePercent.description: Current usage percentage of EU-Horizon indirect-25% cap. Warning fires at >=90% per REQ-RDS-005.

horizonIndirect25Warning.description: TRUE when EU-Horizon indirect-25% usage is >=90% of cap. Per REQ-RDS-005.
horizonIndirect25Warning.warningMessage: indirect-25% limit of EUR {{horizonIndirect25MaxBedrag}} approaching; current usage {{horizonIndirect25UsagePercent}}%

Kostenpost.title: Kostenpost
Kostenpost.description: Individual expense line item within a subsidie dossier. Linked to parent Subsidie via subsidieId. The allowed kostencategorie values are constrained per-regeling via JSON Schema allOf/if-then blocks (REQ-RDS-002). MIT: personnel/materials/external-services/equipment-depreciation/other-direct. SBIR: personnel/materials/equipment-depreciation/other-direct. EU Horizon: personnel/subcontracting/other-direct/indirect-25-percent. EFRO: personnel/external-services/materials/equipment/other/indirect-flat-rate. REACT-EU: EFRO + green-recovery. No PHP category validator per ADR-031.

subsidieRegeling.description: Denormalized regeling from parent Subsidie. Drives if/then kostencategorie constraint enforcement at save time (REQ-RDS-002).

kostencategorie.description: Expense category for this kostenpost. Allowed values are constrained per subsidieRegeling (REQ-RDS-002).

periodId.description: FK to FiscalPeriod this kostenpost covers.

attachmentUri.description: docudesk URI of supporting documentation. Per ADR-022.

soUrenStaatUri.description: docudesk URI of the S&O-uren-staat for personnel kostenposten in EU-Horizon subsidies. Referenced in Horizon audit-pack per REQ-RDS-004.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this record.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Universal product master data — SKU, name, category, pricing, barcodes, and status. Foundation for POS, procurement, and inventory workflows per REQ-IPC-001 through REQ-IPC-010. SKU uniqueness is scoped to (organizationId, sku) to support multi-tenant Nextcloud instances.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit identifier. Unique per (organizationId, sku) per REQ-IPC-002 D2.

category.description: Product category. Standard values: office, it_hardware, logistics, food_beverage, clothing. Custom values allowed for extensibility.

description.example: 13-inch FHD display, Intel Core i7, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD

unitPrice.description: Unit price for purchase or sale in the specified currency per REQ-IPC-002.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for unitPrice.

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT unit of measure code. ST=piece, KG=kilogram, L=litre, HR=hour. Null means each/piece.

taxRate.description: Applicable VAT/tax rate as a percentage (0-100). E.g. 21 for Dutch standard VAT.

primaryBarcode.description: Primary barcode for fast product lookup (e.g. GTIN-13 or custom).

barcodes.description: Multiple barcodes per REQ-IPC-005. Each entry carries code, format (GTIN-8/12/13/14/custom), and type (item/case/pallet).

type.description: Barcode scope: item (single unit), case (multiple units), pallet (full pallet).

status.description: Product lifecycle status per REQ-IPC-009. active = in normal use; discontinued = phased out.

organizationId.description: FK to the organization owning this product. Combined with sku forms the uniqueness key per D2. Queries MUST be scoped per organization per REQ-IPC-010.

ProductAttribute.title: Product Attribute
ProductAttribute.description: Attribute type definitions for products per REQ-IPC-003 and REQ-IPC-004. Category-scoped via applicableToCategories. Seed templates for common categories shipped in lib/Settings/seeds/ per REQ-IPC-006.

name.description: Attribute display name recognizable to procurement practitioners.

dataType.description: Value data type for this attribute per REQ-IPC-004.

applicableToCategories.description: Comma-separated product categories to which this attribute applies per D4. E.g. 'it_hardware' or 'it_hardware,office'.

isRequired.description: Whether this attribute is mandatory for products in applicable categories.

displayOrder.description: Sequence number for UI ordering (ascending). Lower numbers appear first.

validationRule.description: Validation constraint as a human-readable string. E.g. 'min: 4, max: 256' for number ranges or 'SSD, HDD, hybrid' for enum values.

status.description: Attribute lifecycle status. active = in use; archived = retired but retained for history.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Physical or virtual storage location in the warehouse hierarchy (warehouse → zone → bin → in-transit). Hierarchical parent-child FK (parentLocationId) enables rollup stock visibility and inter-location transfers per REQ-LOC-001 through REQ-LOC-009 and design.md D1-D6. No parallel warehouse table in PHP per ADR-031 — location hierarchy is pure declarative metadata.

locationCode.description: Operator-assigned location code unique per administration per REQ-LOC-002 and D5. Immutable after creation — operator must create new location + migrate stock if rename required. Examples: 'W-01', 'Z-01', 'B-100', 'IN-TRANSIT-W01-W02'.

locationType.description: Location type in warehouse hierarchy per REQ-LOC-002 D1. warehouse = physical site (no parent); zone = area within warehouse; bin = most-granular storage unit; in-transit = virtual holding for transfers per D2.

parentLocationId.description: FK to parent Location id per REQ-LOC-001 D1. Null for warehouse and in-transit types (top-level or virtual). Required for zone and bin types. Max hierarchy depth 4 per REQ-LOC-003.

address.description: Physical address of warehouse (street + city). Applicable to warehouse type only.

region.description: Geographic region for rollup reporting filters per REQ-LOC-007.

binNamingConvention.description: Administration-level bin naming preference per Task 6. One of: bin, slot, compartment, location. Defaults to 'bin'.

capacity.description: Maximum storage capacity in operator-defined units. Used for capacity warning per REQ-LOC-009.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this location per REQ-LOC-008. All location queries are scoped to this administration — cross-org access is rejected with 403.

notes.description: Optional operator notes about this location.

active.label: Active
active.description: Location is operational and accepts stock movements.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Location is temporarily unavailable. Stock remains; no new movements.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Location is retired. Historical stock records are read-only.

deactivate.label: Deactivate
deactivate.description: Temporarily close this location for new stock movements.

reactivate.label: Reactivate
reactivate.description: Re-open this location for stock movements.

archive.label: Archive
archive.description: Permanently retire this location.

zoneRequiresParent.condition: locationType IN ('zone', 'bin') AND parentLocationId IS NULL
zoneRequiresParent.message: Zone and bin locations require a parentLocationId.
zoneRequiresParent.messageNl: Zone- en bin-locaties vereisen een bovenliggende locatie.

warehouseNoParent.condition: locationType IN ('warehouse', 'in-transit') AND parentLocationId IS NOT NULL
warehouseNoParent.message: Warehouse and in-transit locations must not have a parent.
warehouseNoParent.messageNl: Warehouse- en in-transit-locaties mogen geen bovenliggende locatie hebben.

maxDepth.message: Location hierarchy exceeds maximum depth of 4.

noCircularReference.message: Circular reference detected in location hierarchy.

locationCodeImmutable.message: Location code cannot be changed after creation per REQ-LOC-002. Create a new location and migrate stock.
locationCodeImmutable.messageNl: Locatiecode kan na aanmaak niet worden gewijzigd. Maak een nieuwe locatie aan en migreer de voorraad.

childCount.description: Number of direct child locations per REQ-LOC-007.

descendantCount.description: Total descendant locations at all depth levels (recursive) per REQ-LOC-007.

stockRollup.description: Warehouse/zone-level stock quantity = SUM(InventoryStock.quantity for all descendant bin locations) per REQ-LOC-005. Excludes in-transit stock. Returns aggregate per SKU.

performance.scaleNote: 1000+ bins under warehouse returns aggregate in < 50ms per REQ-LOC-003

inTransitStock.description: Stock currently in-transit to/from this location per REQ-LOC-004.

hierarchyPath.description: Full path from warehouse to this location (e.g., 'W-01 / Z-01 / B-100') per D5.

hierarchyDepthValue.description: Depth of this location in the hierarchy (0=warehouse, 1=zone, 2=aisle, 3=bin) per REQ-LOC-003.

stockAvailabilityBadge.description: UI badge: 'In Stock', 'Low Stock', 'Empty', or 'Over Capacity' based on stockRollup vs capacity per REQ-LOC-019.

warehouse_manager.description: Full location management including hierarchy setup and deactivation.

inventory.description: Can view and update stock at locations; cannot create/delete hierarchy.

auditor.description: Read-only access to locations for audit trail review.

adminScope.description: Operators can only view/edit locations in their own administration per REQ-LOC-008.

InventoryStockTransfer.title: Inventory Stock Transfer
InventoryStockTransfer.description: Inter-location transfer of stock between any two locations in the warehouse hierarchy per REQ-LOC-006. Transfer updates source and destination InventoryStock quantities. Optional GL integration via StockMove (if inventory-stock-movement-ledger is present). No PHP TransferService — transfer workflow is declarative per ADR-031.

sourceLocationId.description: FK to source Location per REQ-LOC-006. Any location type (warehouse/zone/bin).

destinationLocationId.description: FK to destination Location per REQ-LOC-006. Must differ from source.

sku.description: Product SKU being transferred. References Product.sku.

quantity.description: Quantity to transfer. Must be positive and ≤ available stock at source.

completedDate.description: Actual transfer completion date (when stock arrives at destination).

glPosted.description: Whether GL reclassification entry has been posted (optional, requires add-shillinq-general-ledger).

administrationId.description: FK to Administration owning this transfer. Scoped per org.

confirm.label: Confirm transfer
confirm.description: Confirm transfer intent. Reserves stock at source.

ship.label: Mark as shipped
ship.description: Stock departs source location. In-transit holding location receives stock per D2.

receive.label: Mark as received
receive.description: Stock arrives at destination. InventoryStock updated atomically: source −qty, dest +qty. GL entry posted if GL present.

InventoryStock.title: Inventory Stock
InventoryStock.description: Stock level per SKU at a specific bin Location per REQ-LOC-009 and inventory-stock-tracking spec. Always recorded at bin level (most-granular); warehouse/zone aggregation via Location.stockRollup. locationId FK references bin-type Location only.

locationId.description: FK to Location (must be bin type per REQ-LOC-009). Aggregation queries traverse hierarchy upward.

quantity.description: On-hand stock quantity at this bin location.

reservedQuantity.description: Quantity reserved for pending orders (not available for new allocations).

unitCost.description: Unit cost at this location for inventory valuation.

lastMovementDate.description: Date of most recent stock movement at this location.

administrationId.description: FK to Administration. Scoped per org.

WBSOTag.title: WBSO Tag
WBSOTag.description: WBSO project code register per REQ-WBSO-002 — SO (Stand-alone Project), TWO (TechnoWise Open), SMART (SME Collaboration) and custom codes per WBSO legislation. Administration-configurable; not hardcoded. Per ADR-024 this is a full OR register, not a config table.

wbsoCode.description: Official WBSO project code (SO, TWO, SMART) or custom code per WBSO legislation. Not an enum — operators may add custom codes per subsidy agreement (REQ-WBSO-002).

displayName.description: Dutch display name of the WBSO code shown in UI and exports (REQ-WBSO-002).

description.description: RVO alignment notes and subsidy conditions for this code.
description.example: Solo R&D project funded by WBSO subsidy — no collaborative partner required.

rvoCertificationUrl.description: Link to the official RVO directive or legislation reference for this code.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this WBSO code entry.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of this code.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Code is recognized by RVO and eligible for WBSO tagging.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Code is retired but historical entries remain queryable for audit.

deprecated.label: Vervallen
deprecated.description: Code is no longer accepted by RVO for new subsidy applications.

archive.label: Archiveer code
archive.description: Retire an active WBSO code; existing tagged entries remain valid.

deprecate.label: Markeer als vervallen
deprecate.description: Mark code as no longer accepted by RVO for new applications.

reactivate.label: Reactiveer code
reactivate.description: Restore an archived code to active status.

WBSOActivityCode.title: WBSO Activity Code
WBSOActivityCode.description: Activity classification register per REQ-WBSO-003 — A-codes (allowed R&D activities) and B-codes (non-eligible overhead). Baseline codes ship with the app; administrations may add custom variants via parentActivityCode FK (REQ-WBSO-009).

activityCode.description: Activity code identifier: A001–A999 for allowed R&D activities, B001+ for restricted/overhead, or custom per subsidy agreement (REQ-WBSO-003).

category.description: RVO activity category for grouping and reporting (REQ-WBSO-003).

isAllowed.description: true = eligible for WBSO subsidy hours; false = tracked but excluded from RVO submission totals (REQ-WBSO-003).

parentActivityCode.description: FK to the baseline WBSOActivityCode.activityCode this entry is a custom variant of. Custom variants inherit isAllowed from parent unless explicitly overridden (REQ-WBSO-009).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this code entry.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of this activity code.

active.label: Actief
active.description: Code is valid and assignable to time entries.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Code is retired; existing tagged entries remain queryable.

deprecated.label: Vervallen
deprecated.description: Code is no longer accepted per current RVO directive.

archive.label: Archiveer code
archive.description: Retire activity code.

reactivate.label: Reactiveer code
reactivate.description: Restore archived code to active status.

WBSOExportLog.title: WBSO Export Log
WBSOExportLog.description: Tracks WBSO uren-export operations and their RVO validation lifecycle per REQ-WBSO-005. Lifecycle: draft → generated → validated → submitted → archived (with generated → rejected fallback). Validation guards enforce complete WBSO tagging on all included Urenregistratie entries before allowing RVO submission (REQ-WBSO-006).

exportId.description: Unique export identifier in the format EXP-{YEAR}-{PERIOD}-{SEQ} (REQ-WBSO-005).

periodStart.description: Start of the export date range (inclusive), typically fiscal quarter start (REQ-WBSO-005).

periodEnd.description: End of the export date range (inclusive), typically fiscal quarter end (REQ-WBSO-005).

exportFormat.description: Output format for the RVO submission (REQ-WBSO-005, REQ-WBSO-007).

recordCount.description: Number of Urenregistratie entries included in this export (REQ-WBSO-005).

totalHours.description: Total eligible hours (A-codes) included in the export. Excludes B-code entries (REQ-WBSO-005).

totalHoursIneligible.description: Total non-eligible hours (B-codes) tracked but excluded from RVO submission totals (REQ-WBSO-005).

exportFilters.description: Filter parameters applied on export generation: wbsoTagId, activityCodeId, isAllowed, employee, date range (REQ-WBSO-008).

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the export file was materialized (REQ-WBSO-005).

validationErrors.description: List of validation error messages. Empty array if validated successfully; populated on rejection (REQ-WBSO-006).

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when submitted to RVO portal or operator marked submission complete (REQ-WBSO-005).

fileUri.description: Storage path or cloud URL of the generated export file (REQ-WBSO-005).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this export log.

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Export configuration in progress; no file materialized yet.

generated.label: Gegenereerd
generated.description: Export file materialized; awaiting RVO validation.

validated.label: Gevalideerd
validated.description: RVO validation passed; all entries carry complete WBSO tags.

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Submitted to RVO portal or operator recorded manual upload.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Submission cycle complete; export retained for 7-year audit trail.

rejected.label: Afgewezen
rejected.description: Validation failed or operator cancelled; validationErrors populated.

generate.label: Genereer export
generate.description: Operator selects date range, format, and filters; export record is created. File materialization is deferred to T4.

validate.label: Valideer voor RVO
validate.description: Run RVO validation: all included Urenregistratie entries MUST have non-null wbsoTagId + activityCodeId; isAllowed MUST match entry eligibility (REQ-WBSO-006).

submit.label: Markeer als ingediend
submit.description: Operator uploads to RVO portal or clicks Mark submitted; sets submittedAt timestamp.

archive.label: Archiveer
archive.description: Close the submission cycle; retain export for audit.

reject.label: Wijs af
reject.description: Validation failed or operator cancels; validationErrors array MUST be populated before transition.

regenerate.label: Opnieuw genereren
regenerate.description: Reset to draft for correction and re-generation.

wbsoExportTotals.description: Compute totalHours (eligible) and totalHoursIneligible (non-eligible) from Urenregistratie entries matching this export's period range (REQ-WBSO-006).

untaggedEntryCount.description: Count of Urenregistratie entries in the export period where wbsoTagId or activityCodeId is null. Used by the validation guard to detect incomplete tagging (REQ-WBSO-006).

iv3-xml-transformation.name: IV3 XML Transformation
iv3-xml-transformation.description: Maps an Iv3Export record (with aggregated buckets) to the CBS IV3-bestand XML structure. ADR-031 declarative path — preferred over a PHP renderer. If OR's mapping engine cannot express CBS mixed-content XML nodes, the Iv3XmlRenderer::render() exception path (documented in openspec/changes/add-shillinq-iv3-reporting/design.md §D3) applies.

wbso-rvo-csv-format.name: WBSO RVO CSV Export Format
wbso-rvo-csv-format.description: Declares the RVO-required CSV column structure for WBSO uren-export (REQ-WBSO-007, RVO Administratie Directives 2026-05-21). T4 attaches the outbound computation; T2 declares the field shape only.

wbso-rvo-xml-format.name: WBSO RVO XML Export Format
wbso-rvo-xml-format.description: Declares the RVO portal XML element structure for automated WBSO submission (REQ-WBSO-007, RVO Administratie Directives 2026-05-21). T4 emits the file; T2 declares the schema only.

objects.name: Bank Transaction Polling
objects.description: Periodic polling workflow that calls the openconnector PSD2 aggregator source by slug, normalises aggregator JSON to CAMT.053 format, attaches the document via docudesk, and creates BankStatement records. Runs 4× daily per REQ-BC-004 + ADR-031 path 2. No shillinq-side TimedJob.

objects.findingsSummary: Kritieke bevinding: overschrijding tekenbevoegdheid (€450.000 zonder mandaat). Herstel niet tijdig afgerond — remediëring verloopt.
objects.observationsSummary: Drie governance-observaties t.a.v. inkoopproces, budgetbeheer en periodieke mandaatcontroles.
objects.remediationRecommendations: 1. Onmiddellijk mandaatregister actualiseren. 2. Terugbetalingsregeling treffen voor bedrag boven mandaat. 3. Kwartaalcontrole op tekenbevoegdheden implementeren.
